desc_zh: 石墙之上，三层金顶叠起，顶脊有金饰与飞禽形脊兽。深红饰带与白旗轻轻垂下，窗框是冷静的蓝。右下角橙顶小楼与常青树占住一角，阳光干净，阴影利落。
desc_en: Three tiers of gilded roofs rise above grey stone walls, crowned with golden finials and bird-like ridge ornaments. A deep red band and small white flags hang quietly; blue-framed windows keep a cool note. An orange-roofed annex and evergreens hold the lower corner under sharp, high-altitude light.

desc_zh: 近处石屋覆着鲜亮的橙红屋顶，脊上一点金饰。暗绿山坡横在中间，远处雪斑覆着浑圆的峰顶。头上是无云的深蓝，光从右上方打下，屋檐阴影清晰。
desc_en: A stone building wears a vivid orange-red roof, a small golden finial on its ridge. A dark forested slope fills the middle; beyond it, a rounded peak holds patches of snow. The sky is cloudless blue, and light from the upper right cuts a clean shadow along the eaves.

desc_zh: 仰看多层金檐，角端翘起，脊上有法轮与卧鹿。檐下彩绘梁枋层层叠叠，黑幕上绣着白纹。钴蓝色天空托着金属的反光，光硬、色净。
desc_en: Looking up at layered golden eaves with upturned corners, a Dharma wheel and kneeling deer on the ridge. Painted brackets stack beneath; a black banner carries white embroidery. Cobalt sky holds the metal’s shine—hard light, clean color.

desc_zh: 门上方黑幕横展，白线绘出法轮、卧鹿与吉祥结。金顶脊饰立在明蓝天空下，檐下彩带细密。下方白石栏与几何纹带把画面压住，光影分明，气氛安静。
desc_en: A black banner spans the doorway, white lines drawing a Dharma wheel, deer, and endless knots. Golden ridge ornaments stand against a clear blue sky; colorful friezes run under the eaves. A white stone rail and geometric band anchor the frame—sharp light, quiet air.

desc_zh: 宽阔白石阶通向金顶殿宇，深红墙面与白基座分层清晰。背后山体干燥褐黄，顶上仍留雪痕。几人走在台阶上，尺度一下被拉开；左下角遮阳伞与冷杉点出日常。
desc_en: Broad white stone stairs climb toward gilded temple roofs; deep red walls and white bases stack in clear tiers. Behind them a dry brown mountain still holds streaks of snow. A few figures on the steps give scale; an umbrella and firs at the lower left keep a quiet everyday note.

desc_zh: 暗红木墙托着多层金瓦顶，三枚金刹立在脊上。白栏与彩绘窗框横过中层，背后雪斑山峰贴着蓝天。日光直射，金属瓦面微微发亮，空气清冽。
desc_en: Dark red timber walls carry multi-tiered golden roofs with three ridge spires. A white balcony rail and painted window frames cross the middle story; a snow-patched peak sits against blue sky. Direct sun makes the metal tiles glint; the air feels thin and clear.

desc_zh: 灰石基座上，红墙挂着黄红竖旗，两层金顶在光里发亮。背后山脊雪痕交错，蓝天里有一抹白云。左上角一只鸟正飞过，阴影把山体刻得更深。
desc_en: Above a grey stone base, red walls hold yellow-and-red banners; two tiers of golden roofs catch the sun. Snow streaks the ridge behind; a soft cloud drifts in deep blue. A bird crosses the upper left, and shadows cut the mountain darker.

desc_zh: 左侧金龙形檐饰探入画面，右侧石柱顶立金翅鸟，柱上挂着「观音寺」红幡与转经轮。山谷里针阔混交，远处山脊淡去。天色阴柔，金与石的反差安静。
desc_en: A golden dragon-like eave ornament enters from the left; a stone pillar bears a winged figure, a red Guanyin Temple banner, and a prayer wheel. Mixed forest fills the valley; distant ridges fade under soft overcast light. Gold against stone keeps a quiet contrast.

desc_zh: 层层金檐围着青绿壁面，顶尖细刹垂下小铃。金栏与花叶纹雕满檐口，下方还有一截素色瓦顶。浅蓝天空均匀，光不刺眼，把工艺的细节一一托出。
desc_en: Layered golden eaves wrap a teal wall; a slender spire hangs small bells. A gold rail and floral filigree line the cornices above a quieter tiled roof. Soft pale-blue sky keeps the light even, letting every carved detail read clearly.

desc_zh: 木廊一侧双层转经轮——上排金黄，下排银亮。红衣僧人背影向前，手将及轮。天花有彩绘与经文，侧光落在地板与金属面上，脚步与轮声仿佛都变轻了。
desc_en: Along a wooden corridor, two rows of prayer wheels—matte gold above, bright silver below. A monk in maroon walks ahead, hand near a wheel. Painted beams and script line the ceiling; side light softens the floor and metal, as if steps and turns grow quieter.

desc_zh: 戴黄尖帽的僧人走在前，红袍落在木地板上。右侧长列转经轮伸向远处，红柱托着上下两层。天花深蓝，有金色字迹；左侧敞向柔光，走廊像一条缓慢的线。
desc_en: A monk in a yellow peaked cap leads in maroon robes along wooden planks. A long row of prayer wheels stretches ahead on red posts, stacked in two tiers. Dark blue beams carry gold lettering; soft daylight opens on the left, turning the corridor into a slow line.

desc_zh: 前景是多层金顶与深红寺墙，光是阴天的柔光。背后山坡密布暗红小屋，黄栏小径与白色路灯穿插其间。远近被压扁，红与金叠成一片安静的密度。
desc_en: Foreground holds multi-tiered golden roofs and deep crimson walls under soft overcast light. Behind them a hillside is packed with dark red dwellings, yellow-railed paths and white lamps threading through. Telephoto compression stacks red and gold into a quiet density.

desc_zh: 下方金顶寺院占住近景，黑白饰带横过檐下。整面山坡几乎被暗红木屋铺满，直到画框上沿。阴天光均匀，尺度感来自那些重复的窗与窄径。
desc_en: Golden-roofed monastic buildings fill the near ground, black-and-white bands under the eaves. The entire hillside is carpeted in dark red wooden houses up to the frame’s edge. Even overcast light; scale arrives through repeating windows and narrow paths.

desc_zh: 一人粉帽黑背心，腰间挂着羽绒服，左手攥着念珠。身边多是酒红僧袍，远处山坡有雪。细雪在空中，天色灰白，光很软，脚步朝向同一方向。
desc_en: Someone in a pink visor and black vest walks ahead, a puffy coat at the waist, prayer beads in hand. Maroon robes move nearby; snow patches the distant slope. Fine flakes hang in soft grey light as the group shares one direction.

desc_zh: 几人走在木栈道上：黄帽红袍、粉衫格纹披肩、青绿衣与花头巾。右侧殿角金饰与彩绘清晰，远处雪山隐在阴云下。气氛不急，像一场缓慢的前往。
desc_en: Figures move along a wooden walkway—yellow cap and maroon robes, a pink shirt under a plaid shawl, lime green and a patterned wrap. A carved golden eave sits to the right; snowy hills wait under heavy cloud. No hurry—only a slow going forward.

desc_zh: 高处俯看，深红寺群金顶层层，一处转经亭落在底部中央。山上小红屋密到几乎没有空隙，窄路与一抹蓝车穿行其间。阴天把颜色压得沉稳，不刺眼。
desc_en: From above, crimson temples stack golden roofs; a prayer-wheel pavilion sits at bottom center. Small red houses pack the slope with almost no gaps; a narrow road and a blue truck thread through. Overcast light keeps the colors deep and calm.

desc_zh: 多层金顶与青绿壁面叠起，法轮与卧鹿立在中层，风铃细线垂下。檐角龙首清晰，花叶纹填满边缘。浅蓝天空微有薄雾，画面底部隐约露出一个人头顶。
desc_en: Tiered gold roofs rise over a green drum wall; a Dharma wheel and deer sit mid-level, wind bells on thin lines. Dragon-head corners and lace-like filigree fill the eaves. Soft blue sky holds a light haze; the top of a head appears at the very bottom for scale.

desc_zh: 近处僧人酒红袍、芥黄帽、黑口罩，侧身走过。右侧木栏有法轮纹样，金顶檐角垂着小铃。远山在阴云下发灰，光柔，衣料与金属各自发亮。
desc_en: A monk in crimson robes, mustard hood, and black mask passes close by. A wooden rail shows Dharma-wheel motifs; golden eaves hang small bells. Distant hills turn grey under cloud; soft light lets cloth and metal each keep their own shine.

desc_zh: 一行红袍沿木廊走远，身影略有虚化。右侧金顶与龙形檐饰占住中景，彩绘与木栏细密。背后雪山压在阴云下，暖金与冷山并置，节奏慢。
desc_en: A line of maroon robes walks away along the wooden path, slightly soft with motion. Golden roofs and dragon eaves hold the middle right, painted details and carved rails close by. Snow peaks wait under cloud—warm gold against cold mountain, a slow rhythm.

desc_zh: 暗红木屋密布山坡，黄栏混凝土阶折线爬升。两名红衣身影走在中段，白灯与电线杆点缀其间。阴天光平，红与黄的对比干净，不喧闹。
desc_en: Dark red wooden houses pack the slope; a concrete stair with yellow rails zigzags upward. Two figures in maroon climb mid-frame; white lamps and poles sit among the roofs. Flat overcast light—red against yellow, clean and quiet.

desc_zh: 高处望去，整片谷地与山坡被暗红小屋铺满，几座金顶寺院落在中央。浅色小路与一条主路切开红海，远处褐丘在阴天下显得干燥。尺度大，却几乎没有声响。
desc_en: From high above, dark red dwellings carpet the valley and slopes; a few golden-roofed halls sit near the center. Pale paths and one main road cut the red field; dry brown hills wait under overcast sky. Huge scale, almost no sound.

desc_zh: 夜色里，谷中与坡上亮起点点暖橙灯火，铺成一片细密的光毯。中左几座多层建筑屋顶更亮，左侧高处另有一团集中的光。两条亮路弯过前景，黑暗把轮廓托得更清楚。
desc_en: At night, warm orange lights carpet the valley and slopes in a dense shimmer. Multi-story roofs glow brighter at center-left; another cluster sits on a rise farther left. Two lit roads curve through the foreground; darkness sharpens every outline.

desc_zh: 近处炭灰色岩脊如刃竖起，夹着褐绿灌丛。左中有一条细土路，低处盆地里散落着小小屋舍。远方丘峦偏暖，顶上灰蓝云层厚重，中间留一处稍亮的云隙。
desc_en: Charcoal rock ridges rise like blades, with brown-green scrub between them. A thin dirt track winds left; a few small structures sit in a grassy basin. Distant hills turn warmer under a heavy blue-grey cloud deck, with one brighter break near center.

desc_zh: 山谷底部一小簇白墙红檐屋舍，之上是层层荒脊。远峰罩着蓝雾，一处顶上薄雪。天空淡蓝，有细云拖尾；焦距压扁了距离，人烟显得极小。
desc_en: A small cluster of white-and-red buildings sits in the valley floor; barren ridges stack above. Distant peaks hold blue haze, one summit lightly snowed. Pale sky with thin cloud trails; telephoto compression makes the settlement feel very small.

desc_zh: 深灰岩柱密立，白色木栈道在其间弯折，行人衣色零星点亮。右侧木亭立在岩脊上，远处雪山在阴云下发白。天色沉，尺度由那些小小身影给出。
desc_en: Dark grey stone pillars crowd the frame; a white wooden boardwalk snakes between them, tiny colorful figures for scale. A timber pavilion sits on a ridge to the right; snow peaks pale under heavy cloud. Somber sky—scale arrives only from those small walkers.

desc_zh: 白色宇航人偶立在炭灰色侵蚀脊上，背向镜头，像在望向别处。地表沟壑深、几乎无绿，光平而冷。玩具与荒原并置，气氛疏离，却不吵闹。
desc_en: A white astronaut figurine stands on a charcoal eroded ridge, facing away as if looking elsewhere. Deep fissures, almost no green; light flat and cold. Toy against wasteland—distant, quiet, without noise.

desc_zh: 前景深灰坡面布满竖向冲沟，背后峰脊却近乎白灰。天空阴白，没有硬影。远处一道褐金缝隙露出来，整幅几乎单色，只留纹理与轮廓。
desc_en: A dark grey foreground slope is cut by vertical channels; behind it, ridges turn almost ash-white. The sky is overcast white, no hard shadow. A thin brown-gold gap shows far off—nearly monochrome, all texture and edge.

desc_zh: 浅木栈道在雪坡上曲折上行，通向峰顶一座深色三角形建筑，彩旗在风里。坡上有石堆与细小人影，天蓝夹着薄云。光亮而散，雪面干净。
desc_en: A pale wooden boardwalk zigzags up the snowfield toward a dark triangular structure at the summit, prayer flags in the wind. Rock cairns and tiny figures mark the slope; blue sky holds thin cloud. Bright, diffuse light—the snow reads clean.

desc_zh: 深色山脊覆着斑驳薄雪，下方谷地有一线青绿水色。头顶积云柱状升起，边缘受光，基部偏暗。蓝白与炭褐对峙，冷，但开阔。
desc_en: Dark ridges hold a dappled skim of snow; a turquoise glint sits in the valley below. A cumulus column rises overhead—lit edges, shaded base. Blue-white against charcoal brown: cold, and open.

desc_zh: 近坡薄雪与暗植被交错，一条土路横过。中景两座铁塔立在雪地上，远峰厚雪，低云贴着山顶。天空高蓝，几缕细云，光从右上洒下。
desc_en: A near slope mixes thin snow and dark vegetation; a dirt road cuts across. Two transmission towers stand mid-ground; farther peaks hold thick snow with low cloud on their crests. High blue sky, wispy clouds, light from the upper right.

desc_zh: 前景雪坡斜切，中景深色山脊横列，高压线细白横过。上空积云翻涌，暗底亮边，谷底偶有强光。冷蓝、白、炭褐并置，天气正在变。
desc_en: A snowy foreground slope cuts diagonally; dark ridges run mid-frame with thin white power lines. Cumulus churns above—dark undersides, bright edges; a flare of light in the valley. Cold blue, white, and charcoal—weather in motion.

desc_zh: 左下雪脊斜入，天空占满大部。日在右中，被薄云挡住，下方一整层深蓝灰乌云压住远山。光比强烈，雪与云各自发亮，远处山脊几乎成剪影。
desc_en: A snowy ridge enters from lower left; sky fills most of the frame. The sun sits mid-right behind thin cloud, a deep blue-grey bank pressing the distant hills. High contrast—snow and cloud each bright, far ridges almost silhouette.

desc_zh: 画面大半是云：亮白与奶油色受光，顶层与阴影带是靛蓝灰。下方多层山脊深蓝，远脊有薄雪。光影交替，安静、辽阔，没有多余的色。
desc_en: Most of the frame is sky—bright white and cream where lit, indigo-grey in shadow. Layered ridges below sit deep blue, far crests lightly snowed. Alternating light and shade; quiet, wide, no spare color.

desc_zh: 低处的山脊压成一条暗色剪影，雪还留在褶皱里。头顶的积云层层翻涌，明暗交界处透出一点冷光。细细的输电线路横过前景，像轻轻划过荒野的几道痕迹。
desc_en: The ridge below settles into a dark silhouette, snow still tucked in its folds. Cumulus piles above, a cool light breaking at the edges. Thin power lines cut across the foreground—quiet traces through open wilderness.

desc_zh: 站在高处往下看，近处的雪坡陡直跌入谷底。山谷深处有细细的道路与浅色建筑，像嵌在阴影里的一点生活。远处的雪峰被云雾半掩，天空厚而安静。
desc_en: From high above, the snow slope drops steeply into the valley. A thin road and pale buildings sit deep in shadow. Distant peaks hide behind mist; the sky feels thick and still.

desc_zh: 近处的雪坡斜切画面，岩石从白里露出来。一层层尖峰向后退去，最远处的主峰被薄云轻轻罩住。浅蓝的天与近白的雪，把山写得很静。
desc_en: A snow slope cuts diagonally across the frame, rock showing through the white. Ridges fall away in layers; the farthest summit wears a thin veil of cloud. Pale blue sky and near-white snow keep the mountains quiet.

desc_zh: 晴空下，雪线与裸岩交织成清晰的纹理。一层峰脊推着一层，远处的高大山体带着淡淡的霾。光线干净，把高处的冷与静都留在画面里。
desc_en: Under a clear sky, snow and bare rock weave a sharp texture. Ridges push back in layers; the far massif softens in haze. Clean light holds the cold stillness of high ground.

desc_zh: 一排排雪脊起伏向前，白与深灰交替成节奏。远处更高的峰顶被薄云擦过。天是淡蓝的，云是细细的横线，空间被拉得很开。
desc_en: Snow ridges rise and fall in rhythm—white against deep grey. Higher summits in the distance brush soft cloud. The sky is pale blue, clouds a thin horizontal line; the space feels wide open.

title_en: A Burst of Light in the Valley
desc_zh: 山坡沉在深蓝阴影里，盘山公路弯成细细的银线。谷底忽然亮起一团刺目的反光，像把一天里最后的亮意收成一点。冷色铺满全景，只留这一处白。
desc_en: Slopes sink into deep navy shadow; the mountain road curves as a thin silver thread. At the valley floor, a hard glare of reflected light gathers the day’s last brightness into one point. Cool tones fill the frame—only that white remains.

desc_zh: 大半座山还在冷蓝阴影里，只有最高处被暖光轻轻点亮。薄云绕在峰尖，像不愿散去。深蓝的天把这一抹金色托得更静。
desc_en: Most of the mountain stays in cool blue shadow; only the highest crest catches a soft warm glow. Thin cloud wraps the tip, reluctant to leave. A deep blue sky holds that gold in quiet.

title_en: A Line of Gold on the Peak
desc_zh: 尖峭的主峰立在画面中央，顶端掠过暖金，下部仍是冷白与深蓝。薄云擦过峰尖，天空留出大片留白。一瞬的光，把山写得很轻。
desc_en: A sharp central peak takes the frame; its tip brushes warm gold while the lower slopes stay cool white and navy. Soft cloud skims the summit; the sky leaves wide empty space. A fleeting light makes the mountain feel light.

desc_zh: 金色的暖光落在雪脊阳面，谷底已沉进冷蓝。天际的云也染上浅粉，像和山一起呼吸。高处的视野把远近都压成一层层起伏。
desc_en: Warm gold rests on the sunlit snow ridges; the valley already sinks into cool blue. Horizon clouds take a soft pink, as if breathing with the peaks. From high ground, near and far settle into layered rises.

desc_zh: 近处的雪脊被侧光勾出棱角，阴影处是沉静的蓝灰。远处平顶般的高峰半隐在云里，右侧山谷已全暗。天空带着淡淡粉橙，像一天将尽。
desc_en: Side light sharpens the near snow ridges; shadows hold a quiet blue-grey. A broad distant summit half-hides in cloud; the valley to the right is already dark. Soft pink-orange in the sky marks the day’s end.

desc_zh: 远摄压近的雪壁，金粉与冷蓝在同一座山上相遇。峰顶戴着一缕软云，纹理清晰得像可以触碰。天色干净，把山的体量托得很大。
desc_en: A long lens brings the snow wall close—warm pink-gold meeting cool blue on one face. A soft cloud caps the summit; textures feel almost touchable. Clean sky makes the mountain’s mass feel immense.

desc_zh: 主峰被暖光铺满上半截，谷底与近岭仍是深蓝。平展的帽云停在峰顶，像一块柔软的布。冷暖对照里，山显得既近又远。
desc_en: Warm light covers the upper face of the main peak; near ridges and valleys stay deep blue. A flat cap cloud rests on the summit like soft cloth. In that cool–warm contrast, the mountain feels both near and far.

desc_zh: 前景雪脊沉在冷影里，中央的高峰忽然亮起橙金。一道薄云横过山腰，像轻纱。深蓝的天与层层云，把这一刻的光留住。
desc_en: Foreground snow ridges stay in cool shadow; the central summit suddenly lights up in orange-gold. A thin cloud crosses mid-slope like a veil. Deep blue sky and layered clouds hold this moment of light.

desc_zh: 天空是淡紫与淡蓝，横云带着浅粉。近处雪峰仍冷，远处那座圆顶山却被金光轻轻盖住。树影与裸岩点缀雪坡，像旅途里短暂的停顿。
desc_en: The sky is pale violet and blue; a band of cloud holds soft pink. Near snow stays cold, while a rounded far peak wears a light of gold. Trees and bare rock punctuate the slopes—a brief pause on the journey.

title_en: Warm Light on a Lone Peak
desc_zh: 三角般的主峰被低角度的暖光点亮，周围山体仍是深蓝阴影。一道薄雾横过山腰，天空压着层层暗云。画面很克制，只留这一处亮。
desc_en: A triangular main peak catches low warm light; everything around stays deep blue shadow. A thin mist crosses mid-slope; layered dark clouds press the sky. The frame stays restrained—only this one light.

desc_zh: 主峰与旁边的尖脊同被金橙照亮，阴面落入深蓝。薄云绕在峰间，天色沉静。暖与冷只隔一条光的界线。
desc_en: The main peak and a sharp neighboring ridge share orange-gold light; their shadowed faces fall into deep blue. Soft cloud drifts between them under a quiet sky. Warm and cold meet along a single line of light.

desc_zh: 金字塔般的主峰上半截浸在金橙里，下半截与近岭全是冷蓝。横云带淡紫粉，把远近轻轻隔开。望远压缩了层次，山显得更庄重。
desc_en: The upper half of a pyramid peak soaks in orange-gold; the lower slopes and near ridges stay cool blue. Horizontal cloud, faintly lavender, softens near from far. Telephoto compression makes the mountain feel more solemn.

desc_zh: 阴云压低天空，山脊斜切画面。一侧是深绿针叶林，一侧是浅淡的草甸，界线清晰而安静。远处还有一点残雪，提醒这里仍是高处。
desc_en: Heavy cloud lowers the sky; a ridge cuts diagonally across. One side is dark conifer forest, the other a pale alpine meadow—the boundary clear and quiet. A hint of leftover snow reminds you this is still high ground.

title_en: Light Through Cloud into the Valley
desc_zh: 头顶厚云，山坡沉在冷蓝阴影里。一束软光忽然落到谷底草场与屋舍，把翠绿托亮。路细细绕过村落，像一场短暂的晴。
desc_en: Thick cloud overhead; the slopes stay in cool blue shadow. Soft light falls suddenly on meadows and houses in the valley, lifting the green. A thin road winds past the settlement—a brief spell of clear weather.

desc_zh: 近处湖面微微起皱，几根木桩立在水里。两岸密林收成一道 V 形，远处露出带雪的灰岩山脊。阴天的光很匀，水面与山都安静。
desc_en: The lake ripples softly; a few wooden posts stand in the water. Forested slopes meet in a V, revealing snow-patched grey ridges beyond. Overcast light is even—water and mountain alike stay quiet.

desc_zh: 人坐在倒木上，相机挂在胸前，背后是湖水与密林山坡。一侧的树上垂着浅色苔藓，光是阴天的软。旅途里这一下，像给山留个记号。
desc_en: Someone sits on a fallen trunk, camera at the chest; lake and forested slopes behind. Pale moss hangs from a tree to the side; the light is soft overcast. A pause on the road—a small mark left for the mountain.

desc_zh: 深绿的河面横过前景，一截晒白的树干躺在草岛上，倒影清楚。对岸有人走动，远处草地上有几顶帐篷。密林填满背景，光很柔。
desc_en: Dark green river crosses the foreground; a sun-bleached trunk rests on a grassy islet, its reflection clear. People walk the far bank; a few tents sit on the grass. Dense forest fills the back; the light stays soft.

desc_zh: 草坡上立着一排白塔，金色尖顶在中央。后方是黄墙建筑与蜿蜒的白墙，小路爬上更高的山。色彩干净：绿、白、土黄，像高原平常的一日。
desc_en: White stupas stand on the grassy plateau, a golden spire at the center. Behind them, yellow-walled buildings and winding white walls; a path climbs higher. Clean colors—green, white, earth yellow—an ordinary highland day.

title_en: Village at the Foot of the Mountains
desc_zh: 层层山坡铺开灰褐与绿，一条细径落入谷底。村落白墙红顶，嵌在田地与树列之间。阴天的光很散，人烟与荒野并排安静。
desc_en: Layered slopes stretch in grey-brown and green; a thin path drops into the valley. White walls and red roofs nestle among fields and tree lines. Diffused overcast light—settlement and wilderness sit quietly side by side.

desc_zh: 近处两侧岩石坡夹出一道深谷，草甸是浅黄绿。远处山脊层层退后，蓝得发淡。头顶白云很多，天空占了大半幅面，显得特别开阔。
desc_en: Rocky slopes on both sides frame a deep valley; the meadow is pale yellow-green. Ridges fall back in soft blue. White cloud fills much of the sky—the frame feels especially open.

desc_zh: 土路在干褐坡上折返上行，远处有一点橙色小点。低云挡住远山山脚，雪峰从雾缝里露出来。天空厚重，尺度被衬得很小。
desc_en: A dirt road switchbacks up the dry brown slope; a tiny orange speck sits farther on. Low cloud hides the bases of distant peaks; snow summits show through gaps in the mist. Heavy sky makes scale feel small.

title_en: A Glance Back in the Wind
desc_zh: 人站在碎石与矮灌丛上，回头看向镜头，衣角被风吹起。头顶是大片蓝天与丝状白云。低角度把人托进天空，像旅途中随意的一瞬。
desc_en: Someone stands on rock and low scrub, looking back toward the lens; cloth lifts in the wind. Above, wide blue sky and wispy white cloud. A low angle sets the figure into the sky—a casual moment on the road.

desc_zh: 近处褐脊深暗，中景绿岭沉静，远处雪峰从云雾里探出。天空厚云之间露出几道蓝。前景小径尽头有一点营地色，衬出山的大。
desc_en: A dark brown ridge in front, quiet green hills beyond; snow peaks emerge from mist farther out. Between thick clouds, a few streaks of blue. A hint of camp color at the trail’s end makes the mountains feel vast.

title_en: Sea of Cloud and Snow Peaks
desc_zh: 近处深绿山脊沉在下方，谷中铺满软白云雾。远处雪峰与岩壁从雾里升起，与阴天的天空连成一片。层次很清楚，却仍觉得很远。
desc_en: A dark green ridge sits below; soft white mist fills the valley. Distant snow peaks and rock rise from the fog, blending into the overcast sky. The layers are clear—and still feel far away.

title_en: A Look Back in the Rain
desc_zh: 透明伞上挂着雨珠，人回身浅笑，手里还握着一把团扇。背后是红褐矮墙与模糊的绿叶。阴天的光很软，把这一瞬留得很轻。
desc_en: Raindrops bead on a clear umbrella; she turns back with a soft smile, a round fan still in hand. Behind, a low red-brown wall and blurred green leaves. Soft overcast light keeps the moment light.

desc_zh: 深绿树叶从一侧垂下，人撑着透明伞站在湿地上。米白长裙与浅蓝袋，雨天的色很干净。回望的一刻，像把旅途轻轻收进画面。
desc_en: Deep green leaves hang from one side; she stands on wet ground under a clear umbrella. Cream dress and light blue bag keep the rainy palette clean. That glance back tucks the journey softly into the frame.

desc_zh: 人正面站在雨里，透明伞与木扇收在身前。湿路面反着灰光，左侧绿叶压下。表情安静，光是漫射的，没有多余的热闹。
desc_en: She stands facing the camera in the rain, clear umbrella and wooden fan held in front. Wet pavement reflects grey light; green leaves press in from the left. A quiet expression under soft, diffuse light—nothing extra.

desc_zh: 前景是连绵绿树，中间是一排现代高楼，背后是被低云托住的深蓝远山。阴天把城市与山压在同一块冷色里。人在城边，山仍在远处。
desc_en: A band of green trees in front, modern high-rises in the middle, deep blue mountains held by low cloud behind. Overcast light folds city and mountain into one cool palette. At the city’s edge, the mountains remain far.

desc_zh: 浅溪自苔藓石阶逐级而下，水色透亮，泡沫在边缘轻轻翻起。岸边小树探入水中，背景的绿意被压成柔焦。流水不高，却把山间的安静写得很清楚。
desc_en: A shallow stream steps down mossy rock tiers, clear enough to show every edge of foam. Small trees lean into the water; the forest behind softens into blur. The fall is modest, yet the quiet of the mountain feels complete.

desc_zh: 画面大半是细密涟漪的湖蓝，近处松枝虚成一抹前景。水下隐约可见暗色石影，颜色沉而干净。像从林间小径偶一低头，便撞见一整面安静的蓝。
desc_en: Fine ripples of turquoise fill most of the frame, framed by a soft pine branch above. Dark shapes of submerged stone linger just below the surface. It feels like a glance from the trail—and the whole lake answering in blue.

desc_zh: 前景一棵苍松，下部犹有针叶，上部枝干已银白裸露。身后是蓝绿相间的山湖，远峰隐在薄云里。树与水对望，时间感比景色更重。
desc_en: A weathered pine stands in front—needles still cling below, while the upper limbs turn bare and silver. Behind it, a turquoise lake and forested ridges fade into soft cloud. Tree and water face each other; time feels heavier than scenery.

desc_zh: 大片冷蓝湖面铺开，两侧密林山坡收成一道窄口。远峰被低云轻轻遮住，前景虚焦的松枝点出距离。阴天的光把一切压得安静而辽阔。
desc_en: Cool turquoise water opens wide, while forested slopes close into a narrow V. A distant peak softens behind low cloud; a blurred pine tip marks the near edge. Overcast light keeps the scene quiet and vast.

desc_zh: 两人倚在木栏边，身后湖色与山影被虚化成一层柔亮的蓝绿。表情克制，姿态自然，像旅途中随手留下的一张合影。风景在后，人在此刻。
desc_en: Two figures lean on a wooden rail; the lake and mountains melt into soft turquoise behind them. The pose is easy, unforced—a travel portrait taken between steps. Landscape waits in the background; the moment stays with the people.

desc_zh: 俯视一汪蓝绿交织的水面，浅处石子清晰可辨。岸上枯木斜倚入林缘，深色山坡衬出湖色的亮。没有人迹喧闹，只有颜色与纹理。
desc_en: From above, turquoise and deeper blue mosaic the water; pebbles show through the shallows. A barkless log leans from the forest edge, dark green slopes pushing the lake’s color forward. No noise—only tone and texture.

desc_zh: 近处湖蓝微起涟漪，岸线是窄窄的石滩与草地。上方一整面针叶林贴着山坡升起，深浅绿色层层叠叠。水平与垂直的对比，让湖面更安静。
desc_en: Turquoise water ripples gently against a thin strip of rock and grass. Above, a wall of evergreen climbs the slope in layered greens. Horizon and vertical forest hold each other; the lake stays still.

desc_zh: 布满苔藓的枯枝横入画面，阳光在湖蓝水面撒开细碎反光。远岸密林深暗，与近处的亮形成对照。一根旧枝，足够撑起整片闪烁。
desc_en: A lichen-covered bare limb cuts across the frame; sunlight breaks into countless glints on turquoise water. The far bank’s forest stays dark, sharpening the brilliance nearby. One weathered branch is enough to hold the sparkle.

desc_zh: 枝叶虚成前景边框，中间是微微闪光的蓝绿湖面。焦点偏软，像从树影里偶然望见水光。颜色干净，不必多加说明。
desc_en: Soft leaves and branches form a natural frame; turquoise water shimmers at the center. Focus stays gentle, as if the lake were glimpsed through the canopy. The color speaks; little else is needed.

desc_zh: 人蹲在木板栈道旁，指尖刚触到清浅急流。四周绿植与黄花簇拥，水声仿佛能听见。旅途里这样的停顿，往往比远景更难忘。
desc_en: Crouched on wooden planks, a hand reaches until fingertips meet the clear, quick stream. Green foliage and yellow flowers crowd the banks. Such a pause on the road often stays longer than any wide vista.

desc_zh: 高处俯瞰，浅河与公路并肩穿过绿谷，石拱桥与远处高架隐约可见。村落灰瓦嵌在林间，远山淡成一层蓝灰。路与水都在往前走。
desc_en: From high above, a shallow river and a road share the green valley; a stone arch and a distant viaduct sit quietly in place. Grey roofs nestle among trees; ridges fade to blue-grey. Water and road keep moving on.

desc_zh: 沥青路在密林与村舍间弯折前行，旁侧溪流与石桥相伴。远处高架横过谷地，阴天的光把绿压得很深。一条路，把山里与山外轻轻连上。
desc_en: An asphalt road bends between dense woods and village roofs, a stream and stone bridge running alongside. A viaduct crosses the valley far ahead under soft overcast light. One road quietly joins the hills to the world beyond.

desc_zh: 层层绿岭向远退去，厚云压在峰顶，颜色由近绿转远灰。没有强烈的光影，只有空气里的湿润与辽阔。山在阴天里，反而更像山本身。
desc_en: Layered green ridges recede while heavy cloud settles on the peaks, greens cooling into grey. No hard light—only moisture and expanse in the air. On an overcast day, mountains look more like themselves.

desc_zh: 细长竹竿并立向上，叶冠在顶部织成一层透光的绿。偶有树干夹杂其间，天空从缝隙里漏下。站在里面，声音都会变轻。
desc_en: Slender culms rise together; the canopy weaves a translucent green roof. A darker trunk slips in among them; sky leaks through the gaps. Inside, even sound seems quieter.

desc_zh: 仰拍竹梢，竿与叶向天空汇聚，亮处叶缘近乎透明。整片绿色像一座自然的拱顶。抬头一刻，路途的尘土被暂时放下。
desc_en: Shot upward, stalks and leaves converge toward the sky; sunlit edges turn nearly translucent. The green forms a natural vault overhead. For a moment looking up, the road’s dust can wait.

title_en: A Smile on the Bamboo Path
desc_zh: 旅人立在落叶小径上，身后竹竿高耸入画。竖起拇指的瞬间轻松随意，背包与水瓶都还在手边。旅途不必总是沉默，也可以有这一下开心。
desc_en: A traveler stands on a leaf-strewn path, tall bamboo rising behind. A thumbs-up lands easy and unposed; pack and bottle still in hand. Journeys need not stay silent—they can hold a small, bright laugh.

desc_zh: 凤蝶展翅停在白瓣小花上，黑白纹与尾端蓝橙斑清晰可见。背景虚成一片柔绿，把细节全部留给翅面。一息之间的静止，也值得记下来。
desc_en: A swallowtail rests open-winged on small white blossoms; black-and-white bars and blue-orange spots stay sharp. Soft green bokeh keeps the focus on the wing. A pause this brief still deserves a frame.

desc_zh: 蝴蝶悬在半空，足尖伸向黄心白瓣的小花。翅纹纤细，背景草叶化作奶油色虚影。飞行被按下快门的那一刻，变成可停留的安静。
desc_en: Mid-flight, the butterfly reaches toward a daisy with a yellow heart. Wing patterns stay fine; grass softens into creamy blur. The shutter holds the motion still—and turns it quiet.

title_en: A Single Spire Against the Sky
desc_zh: 一株细长针叶树竖直刺入阴云天空，前景野草微微倾斜。远山淡成灰蓝，构图干净，几乎只剩向上的线条。简单，却站得很稳。
desc_en: A slender conifer rises into an overcast sky; tall grass leans in the foreground. Distant hills fade to blue-grey. The frame is nearly only that upward line—simple, and firmly held.

desc_zh: 沥青路缓缓上坡，黄蓝粉三色中线穿过竹林与阔叶树之间。两人背影向前走去，护栏与树冠把路收成一条窄缝。走在绿色里，路标也变得温柔。
desc_en: The asphalt climbs gently; yellow, blue, and pink center lines run between bamboo and broadleaf trees. Two figures walk ahead; guardrail and canopy narrow the road to a soft corridor. Even the markings feel gentle inside the green.

desc_zh: 无数竹竿自下而上，近处节纹清晰，远处溶入柔焦。叶冠过滤日光，绿色层层叠叠。走进深处，方向感会被高度轻轻拿走。
desc_en: Countless bamboo culms rise from below—nodes sharp nearby, softening into depth. The canopy filters daylight into layered green. Deep inside, height quietly takes away any sense of direction.

desc_zh: 大树冠盖展开，两人在树下同时跃起，姿态一收一展。草地与远天衬出这一瞬的轻。旅途里的玩笑，落成一张抬起的照片。
desc_en: Under a broad canopy, two figures jump at once—one arms up, one arms open. Grass and a pale sky catch the lightness of the second. A travel joke lands as a lifted frame.

desc_zh: 虬曲枯木自近景探入灰蓝湖面，枝桠部分没入水中。远山与厚云压得很低，色调近乎素净。画面留白多，情绪却不空。
desc_en: Gnarled wood reaches from the near edge into grey-blue water; thin limbs dip below the surface. Distant ridges and heavy cloud sit low; the palette stays nearly quiet. Much empty space—yet the mood is full.

title_en: Hand in Hand on the Fallen Trunk
desc_zh: 父女并肩站在伸向水面的粗干上，一人挥手，一人微笑握着她的手。阴云湖山作底，绿草在脚边一角。风景很大，牵着的那只手更近。
desc_en: Father and daughter stand on a thick trunk reaching over water—one waving, one smiling, hands linked. Overcast lake and hills hold the distance; a patch of green sits at their feet. The view is wide; the held hand is closer.

desc_zh: 近处一石半浸水中，远处有人坐在枯枝上垂钓。湖面与云层同色，顶上绿叶轻轻入画。安静得像不必等到鱼，光坐着就够。
desc_en: A pale rock sits half in the water; farther out, a figure fishes from a fallen trunk. Lake and cloud share one tone; green leaves drip into the top of the frame. Quiet enough that waiting for a catch feels optional.

desc_zh: 大片微浪铺开，左岸绿树垂影，岸边有人远远站着。远方长岛与山脊横过，厚云翻涌，蓝天偶从缝里露出。水天都宽，人只占很小一角。
desc_en: Gentle waves fill the frame; a green tree leans from the left shore where small figures stand. A long island and ridges cross the distance under rolling cloud, blue sky slipping through. Water and sky stay vast; people take only a corner.

desc_zh: 一串吊椅沿钢缆爬向密林山坡，近处乘客背影清晰，远处椅子渐小。整座山几乎全是绿，旅途在半空里继续。上升本身，就是风景的一部分。
desc_en: A line of chairs climbs the forested slope along the cables; near backs stay clear, distant seats shrink. The mountain is almost all green; the journey continues in mid-air. Rising itself becomes part of the view.

desc_zh: 高处俯见棋盘般的田地与聚落，湖面嵌在远山之前。云影在坡上移动，亮处与暗处交替。大地铺开得很大，像一张慢慢翻开的地图。
desc_en: From above, fields and a settlement grid the valley; a lake sits before distant ridges. Cloud shadow slides across the slopes, light and dark trading places. The land opens wide—like a map turned slowly.

desc_zh: 仰看彩绘斗拱与飞檐，红柱、灰瓦、一盏红灯笼同框。石狮守在近处，石阶向上延伸。工艺的颜色很满，却仍压在一片干净的天空下。
desc_en: Looking up at painted brackets and upswept eaves—red pillars, grey tiles, a single lantern. A stone lion keeps watch; stairs climb toward the hall. Color is rich, yet still held under a clear sky.

desc_zh: 一人举相机对向远山与水面，身体只占画面一角。云压得很低，山脊与湖岸安静地展开。拍风景的人，也成了风景里的一点。
desc_en: A figure lifts a camera toward distant peaks and water, taking only a corner of the frame. Cloud sits low; ridge and shoreline open quietly. The one who frames the view becomes a small part of it.

desc_zh: 近处马匹站在草场与泥地之间，远山被厚云半遮。林线深暗，山谷显得很远。动物与山脉同框，旅途忽然慢了下来。
desc_en: Horses stand between grass and churned earth; peaks beyond half-hide in thick cloud. The treeline stays dark; the valley feels far. Animals and mountains share one frame—and the journey slows.

desc_zh: 枝叶虚成前景，谷底密密的浅色屋顶铺向远山。天光偏冷，山脊泛一点暖意。城市缩成纹理，山仍是主句。
desc_en: Blurred foliage frames a dense carpet of pale roofs filling the valley floor. The light runs cool; a soft warmth touches the nearer ridges. The town becomes texture; the mountains keep the sentence.

title_en: A Thin Band of Light at Dusk
desc_zh: 厚云压暗大半天空，地平线留出一道浅暖光，山影成深蓝剪影。谷中城廓隐约成片，前景是陡坡的针叶林。一日将尽，光仍记得留下一句。
desc_en: Heavy cloud darkens most of the sky; a thin warm band rests on the horizon, mountains cut in deep blue. The valley city softens into a pale mosaic; a steep conifer slope anchors the foreground. Day ending—and light still leaves one last line.

desc_zh: 阴天的湖岸，草地与树影贴着水面铺开。新叶带着一点红，水色浑静，像刚下过雨后的喘息。
desc_en: An overcast lakeshore where lawn and trees lean into still water. New leaves tip with red; the pond rests quiet, as if after rain.

desc_zh: 粉莲浮在圆叶之间，水面映着浅蓝天光。枝叶从上方垂下，把这一池开得克制而分明。
desc_en: Pink water lilies rest among round pads under a pale sky. Leaves hang from above, framing a pond that blooms with quiet clarity.

desc_zh: 树叶框住远方的热气球，倒影也停在水里。岸上人影很小，颜色却成了这一日最轻的一笔。
desc_en: Foliage frames a hot-air balloon; its reflection holds still on the pond. Tiny figures on the shore, and color as the softest mark of the day.

desc_zh: 几朵粉莲抬出水面，瓣尖偏红，蕊心橙亮。圆叶层层铺开，深水把花色托得更干净。
desc_en: Pink lilies rise above the water—tips flushed, centers bright. Pads layer outward; dark water makes the bloom feel cleaner still.

desc_zh: 红、黄、绿叠进同一片叶丛。阳光透过叶脉，近处虚、中景实，像热带里一截被截取的色彩。
desc_en: Red, yellow, and green fold into one thicket. Light passes through the veins—soft near, sharp mid—a slice of tropical color held still.

desc_zh: 更深的红与金黄挤在一起，叶缘几乎发黑。光从缝隙漏进来，热带植物把一天的温度写在叶片上。
desc_en: Deeper red and gold press together, edges nearly black. Light slips through the gaps; tropical leaves keep the day’s warmth on their surface.

desc_zh: 直直的土路被落叶铺满，两侧树干整齐如廊。尽头有一点亮，像走进树林深处才见的出口。
desc_en: A straight path carpeted in fallen leaves, trunks lining both sides like a corridor. Light waits at the end—an exit found deeper in the trees.

desc_zh: 几株棕榈立在修剪过的草地上，树干灰绿分明。午后光斑落在叶影里，园子安静得像刚被打扫干净。
desc_en: Palms stand on a trimmed lawn, trunks grey-green and clear. Afternoon light freckles the fronds; the garden feels freshly quiet.

desc_zh: 粗根沿岩壁垂下，像木的瀑布。抬头看树冠，绿光从叶缝漏出，时间在这里显得特别慢。
desc_en: Thick roots cascade down rock like a wooden waterfall. Looking up, green light slips through the canopy—time moves slower here.

desc_zh: 红砖墙里一扇木窗打开，铜灯与小物安静摆着。玻璃映着绿叶，旧墙与新置之间留着一段闲适。
desc_en: A wooden window opens in red brick; brass lamps and small objects sit still. Glass catches greenery—ease held between old wall and quiet arrangement.

desc_zh: 金黄与朱红在深水里交错游过。涟漪轻轻散开，一池颜色像被搅动后的片刻平静。
desc_en: Gold and crimson weave through dark water. Ripples ease outward—a pond of color settling after a brief stir.

desc_zh: 佛塔金顶刺向淡蓝天空，红衣佛像嵌在砖龛里。棕榈与树叶从两侧围拢，傍晚的光把金属擦得发亮。
desc_en: A golden spire lifts into pale blue sky; a red-robed Buddha rests in a brick niche. Palms and leaves gather at the sides—evening light polishing the metal bright.

desc_zh: 静水横在前景，针叶林贴着对岸。远处雪线与灰岩峰叠起，阴天把整座山谷压得更干净。
desc_en: Still water in front, conifers hugging the far shore. Snow lines and grey peaks stack beyond; overcast light keeps the valley spare and clear.

desc_zh: 银灰枯枝探进浅水，卵石隐约可见。对岸林线与雪峰退远，风把湖面吹成细密的纹理。
desc_en: Silver driftwood reaches into shallow water; pebbles show beneath. Forest and snow peaks pull back; wind writes fine grain across the lake.

desc_zh: 一截枯干从右下斜入画面，湖面灰蓝如镜。两侧山坡一林一雪，高原的静从这里开始。
desc_en: A bleached trunk enters from the lower right; the lake lies grey-blue and still. Forest on one slope, snow on the other—highland quiet begins here.

desc_zh: 未完工的木架立在草甸边，几头牦牛散在近处。背后是浓绿林线与灰岩峰，高原把生活放得很轻。
desc_en: An unfinished timber frame stands by the meadow; yaks rest nearby. Behind, dark forest and grey peaks—highland life held lightly.

desc_zh: 黄绿草甸上牦牛散卧，远处有白帐篷与人影。湖水横过中景，针叶林贴着山坡，一天停在午后。
desc_en: Yaks rest across a yellow-green meadow; a white tent and small figures wait far off. The lake cuts mid-frame, conifers hug the slopes—afternoon held still.

desc_zh: 锯齿雪峰压在湖后，草甸上牦牛成群。木栏与疏树留在左下，辽阔里有一点人间的痕迹。
desc_en: Jagged snow peaks rise behind the lake; yaks gather on the meadow. A wooden fence and sparse trees sit lower left—a thin trace of people in the vast.

desc_zh: 宽阔草甸铺向湖岸，黑点似的牲畜散开。右下一株小松，雪峰横陈其后，冷色把空间拉得更远。
desc_en: A wide meadow runs to the lake; livestock scatter like dark points. A small pine stands lower right, snow peaks beyond—cool tones stretching the space farther.

desc_zh: 牦牛与马背对镜头吃草，湖水与林线贴着山根。灰岩峰顶着薄雪，阴天把一切压成静奢的灰绿。
desc_en: Yaks and horses graze with backs to the lens; lake and forest line the mountain base. Grey peaks hold thin snow—overcast turns all to quiet grey-green.

desc_zh: 雪峰、密林、湖水、草甸层层铺开，牧群点在前景。高原的一天，被切成四道安静的色带。
desc_en: Snow peaks, dense forest, lake, and meadow stack in bands; the herd dots the front. A highland day cut into four quiet stripes of color.

desc_zh: 从高处俯看V形山谷，残雪贴在近坡。远处雪峰被云雾吞没，一条细路在谷底蜿蜒，像旅程留下的线。
desc_en: Looking down a V-shaped valley, residual snow clings to near slopes. Distant peaks dissolve into mist; a thin road winds the floor—like a line left by the journey.

desc_zh: 两侧山坡收成一道深谷，灰路贴着谷底远去。紫褐灌丛与疏林点缀坡面，阴天把距离拉得更长。
desc_en: Slopes close into a deep gorge; a grey road follows the floor away. Purple-brown scrub and sparse trees mark the sides—overcast stretching the distance.

desc_zh: 沙石路在荒坡上画出S形，雪斑留在近角。远山层层退成灰蓝，这一程还没有尽头。
desc_en: A gravel road draws an S across bare slope; snow patches sit near the corner. Ridges fade to blue-grey—the road still has no end in sight.

desc_zh: 人坐在半浸水中的枯木上，钓竿斜向远处。小岛上的绿树与远山对望，阴天湖面安静得像一张纸。
desc_en: Someone sits on a half-submerged fallen trunk, rod angled out. A green tree on a small islet faces distant hills; the overcast lake lies quiet as paper.

title_en: Town under Clouds by the Lake
desc_zh: 高处俯看湖湾与沿岸屋舍，白云压在蓝天上。田野与山影交错，光一块暗一块，像风刚吹过云层。
desc_en: From high ground, a lake bay and shoreline houses sit under white clouds on blue. Fields and hills patch light and shade—as if wind just moved the cloud.

desc_zh: 两条缆线收向山脊，绿椅一节节穿进针叶林。身后的人背影近在眼前，前方的路却长得看不见尽头。
desc_en: Two cables run toward the ridge; green chairs thread a conifer corridor. Passengers sit close behind, while the line ahead disappears into length.

desc_zh: 银灰涟漪占满下半幅，岸上停着几辆车与白帐篷。整座绿山从水边拔起，一缕阳光正好落在坡腰。
desc_en: Silver ripples fill the lower half; cars and white tents rest on shore. A green mountain rises from the water’s edge, one patch of sun catching the slope.

desc_zh: 前景人影虚成轮廓，目光落在远山与湖湾。云雾贴着山脊，草原上散着牲畜，这一刻只剩看与被看。
desc_en: A blurred figure in front looks toward mountains and a lake bend. Mist hugs the ridges; livestock scatter on the plain—only looking, and being looked at.

desc_zh: 背影走在浅绿草地上，湖湾在前方展开。云层压着远山，几户人家贴着谷底，一步一步走近水声。
desc_en: A figure walks across pale green grass toward a lake bend. Clouds weigh on distant mountains; a few houses hug the valley floor—each step closer to water.

desc_zh: 背对镜头张开双臂，湖湾与绿山铺在前方。云层厚重，草地湿冷，这一刻像把整片高原抱进来。
desc_en: Back to the camera, arms open wide—lake bend and green mountains ahead. Heavy clouds, cool grass; a moment that seems to hold the whole highland.

desc_zh: 俯拍草地中张开的身影，河湾绕过，远山被云罩住。人很小，风景很大，却刚好对上。
desc_en: From above, a figure opens arms on the grass; a river bends, mountains wear cloud. Small against the land—and somehow exactly matched.

desc_zh: 浅紫外套的人朝镜头走来，相机挂在胸前。身后湖水与云山安静，旅行的中途，脚步不急。
desc_en: In a pale purple jacket, walking toward the lens, camera at the chest. Lake and clouded peaks behind—mid-journey, unhurried steps.

desc_zh: 目光略垂，步子踏过湿草。对岸有小屋与树丛，云雾贴着山腰，高原的一天写在衣服的褶皱里。
desc_en: Eyes slightly down, steps across damp grass. Houses and trees on the far shore, mist on the slopes—a highland day folded into the jacket.

desc_zh: 人抬起头，神情平静，相机仍在手边。背后的山与云把空间撑开，旅途的表情不必用力。
desc_en: Looking up, calm, camera still at hand. Mountains and cloud open the space behind—no need to force a travel face.

desc_zh: 油漆剥落的小船横在草岸，湖面平静，远山青绿。蓝天堆着白云，时间把船身磨成一张旧照。
desc_en: A peeling boat rests on the grassy bank; the lake is still, hills green beyond. White clouds fill blue sky—time has worn the hull into an old photograph.

desc_zh: 同一处湖岸，船仍横着，水与云略有不同。第二次按下快门，像把这一程再抄一遍。
desc_en: Same shore, the boat still sideways; water and cloud shift a little. A second shutter—copying this stretch of the journey once more.

desc_zh: 人侧身望向远山，耳机与相机都在。泥岸草地、白帐篷与云雾叠在身后，像短暂停顿的听风。
desc_en: Turned sideways toward distant peaks, earbuds in, camera ready. Muddy grass, white tents, and mist stack behind—a short pause to listen to the wind.

desc_zh: 侧影举着相机对准远山，湖水贴着脚边。云雾缠着峰顶，拍摄本身也成了旅途里的姿态。
desc_en: In profile, camera raised toward the peaks, water at the feet. Mist wraps the summits—photographing becomes part of the journey’s pose.

desc_zh: 高处俯看谷底延展的城与村，山脊被金光擦亮。上方便是厚云，蓝时将至，一天被压成一道暖边。
desc_en: From above, town and village fill the valley floor; ridges catch gold. Heavy cloud above, blue hour near—the day pressed into one warm edge.

desc_zh: 深谷两侧山壁陡立，右下白墙村寨簇拥。金顶小筑在其间，蓝天云影把高原村居托得很清楚。
desc_en: Steep walls close a deep valley; white houses cluster lower right. A small golden roof among them—blue sky and cloud lift highland dwellings into clarity.

desc_zh: 大山夹出宽谷，坡面绿褐交错。谷底一点红顶小屋，土路绕过，人烟在风景里只占指甲大小。
desc_en: Mountains open a wide valley, slopes green and brown. A red-roofed hut on the floor, a dirt track nearby—human life the size of a fingernail.

title_en: Sun and Shadow on the Range
desc_zh: 云隙把阳光洒在半边山坡，另一半沉在暗里。谷底圈地与小屋很小，辽阔是这张照片真正的主语。
desc_en: Cloud gaps pour sun on one slope, the other stays dark. A fenced yard and tiny huts below—vastness is the true subject of the frame.

desc_zh: 厚云开出一孔深蓝，山坡光斑游走。谷底绿甸与小屋贴着土路，高原的呼吸写在天空上。
desc_en: Thick cloud opens a deep-blue eye; light patches wander the slopes. Green meadow and a hut by the dirt road—highland breath written across the sky.

desc_zh: 两侧山脊夹出明亮谷地，电塔与土路显出人迹。云层翻涌，远处锯齿峰灰蓝，午后把一切摊开。
desc_en: Ridges open a bright valley floor; pylons and a dirt road mark people. Clouds surge, distant peaks grey-blue—afternoon lays everything out.

desc_zh: 从高处俯看U形谷，河水一弯弯银色前行。公路贴着谷底远去，云影落在湿地与秋色灌丛上。
desc_en: Looking down a U-shaped valley, the river silver-bends ahead. A road follows the floor away; cloud shadow falls on wetland and autumn scrub.

desc_zh: 银河与浅色土路并肩蜿蜒，山脊层层退成蓝紫。云层厚，光影淡，旅途的线被画得很清楚。
desc_en: A silver river and pale track wind side by side; ridges fade to blue-purple. Thick cloud, soft light—the journey’s line drawn clear.

desc_zh: 金黄草坡与深绿针叶夹着细流，远峰灰岩裸露。云隙留一角蓝天，冷色把山谷压得更深。
desc_en: Gold grass and dark conifers hold a thin stream; distant peaks show bare grey rock. A blue scrap in the cloud—cool tones pressing the valley deeper.

desc_zh: 谷口对着雪峰，乌云压顶，一角蓝天刺破。草甸与小溪铺向前，远处有零星屋舍，像抵达的标记。
desc_en: The valley mouths toward a snow peak; dark cloud presses, one blue tear. Meadow and stream run forward; sparse houses wait like marks of arrival.

desc_zh: 前景柏油路弯过，电线杆立着。远方雪峰被乌云半遮，谷底有红顶小屋，旅程就停在这一望之间。
desc_en: A paved bend in front, utility poles upright. Snow peak half-veiled by dark cloud; red roofs in the valley—the journey pauses in this single look.

desc_zh: 左右山坡收成V形，雪峰嵌在尽头。谷底细流银亮，一侧有光一侧有影，山把目光一路送过去。
desc_en: Slopes close into a V; a snow peak locks at the end. A bright stream on the floor, light on one side, shade on the other—the mountains carry the eye all the way.

desc_zh: 大片蓝天与白云压在金绿山脊上，光影在坡面游走。左下隐约有路与电杆，晴天把高原擦得发亮。
desc_en: Wide blue sky and white cloud over a gold-green ridge; light and shade wander the slope. A road and poles faintly below—clear weather polishing the highland bright.

desc_zh: 黑牦牛散在青绿草坡，土路横过中景。背后灌丛与疏松安静，高原的午后只听见啃草的声音。
desc_en: Black yaks scatter on green slope; a dirt track cuts mid-frame. Scrub and sparse pines rest behind—an afternoon that seems to hold only the sound of grazing.

desc_zh: 刻着经文的浅色石板斜立草甸，远处牦牛与针叶林。蓝天白云很近，石头把一段路写成静默。
desc_en: A pale inscribed stone leans on the meadow; yaks and conifers farther off. Blue sky and white cloud feel close—the stone turns a stretch of road into silence.

desc_zh: 巨大白云投下阴影，山脊林线与草甸分明。右下有彩色屋顶的聚落，晴空把高原拉得很开。
desc_en: A great white cloud casts its shade; forest line and meadow read clear on the ridge. Colorful roofs lower right—clear sky opening the highland wide.

desc_zh: 左下一匹棕马静立，蓝河蜿蜒过秋色灌丛。白云压着金褐山脊，旅程在这里多了一个安静的旁观者。
desc_en: A brown horse stands lower left; a blue river winds through autumn scrub. White cloud on a gold-brown ridge—the journey gains one quiet witness.

desc_zh: 人们围着蓝纸告示栏低头细看，棕榈与密叶在后。公园一角的日常，好奇比声音更响。
desc_en: People gather around blue notices, heads bent; palms and dense leaves behind. A park corner’s everyday—curiosity louder than talk.

title_en: A Glance at the Matchmaking Corner
desc_zh: 「男生」字样的牌子下，蓝纸成排，人影背对镜头。绿荫里一场安静的观望，城市把心事挂在绳子上。
desc_en: Under a “young men” sign, blue papers hang in rows; backs to the lens. Quiet watching in the shade—the city hangs private hopes on a string.

desc_zh: 前景孩童虚影骑在肩上，紫衣橙裙的舞者撑着粉伞。公园里一场轻巧的表演，看与被看叠在一起。
desc_en: A child’s blurred back rides a shoulder in front; dancers in purple and orange hold pink umbrellas. A light park performance—watching and being watched layered.

desc_zh: 竹叶与树荫下，粉伞舞者同步抬臂。人群背影虚在前景，公园把节日般的颜色收进平常下午。
desc_en: Under bamboo and shade, pink-umbrella dancers lift arms in sync. Blurred backs fill the front—the park folds festive color into an ordinary afternoon.

desc_zh: 老人抛起粉绿彩球，女孩抬眼追着看。竹叶与砖墙围着小院，玩耍把时间变得很短。
desc_en: An elder tosses pink-and-green pom-poms; a girl looks up to follow. Bamboo and brick enclose a small yard—play making time feel short.

desc_zh: 戴手套的手捏着白色小鸟糖塑，竹叶作背景。摊位一角，专注比嘈杂更显眼。
desc_en: Gloved hands shape a white sugar bird; bamboo soft behind. At a stall corner, focus shows clearer than noise.

desc_zh: 老人单腿踢毽，羽毛刚离脚。前景孩童虚影看着，三角梅与绿植围着广场，活力落在平常天。
desc_en: An elder kicks a shuttlecock on one leg; feathers just leave the foot. A child’s blur watches; bougainvillea and greenery ring the plaza—vitality on an ordinary day.

desc_zh: 白毽停在空中，人仰头盯着。棕榈盆栽与长椅在后，公园把动作凝成一瞬的静止。
desc_en: A white shuttlecock hangs midair; eyes track upward. Potted palm and bench behind—the park freezes motion into one still beat.

desc_zh: 灰发背影俯向棋盘，木子散落石台。绿篱与纸袋在旁，公园把一局棋下得很慢、很安静。
desc_en: A grey-haired back leans over the board; wooden pieces rest on stone. Hedge and a paper bag nearby—the park plays chess slowly, quietly.

desc_zh: 白石拱门刻着「清华园」，蓝天无云。红绳外人群围聚，冬衣与车轮把校园入口写成日常纪念。
desc_en: A white stone arch reads “Tsinghua Garden” under clear blue. Crowds gather beyond a red rope—winter coats and a bicycle wheel making the gate an everyday monument.

desc_zh: 巴洛克式石门裂纹犹在，卷草与柱头尚存。冬树疏枝，天色灰蓝，废墟把光阴留在浮雕上。
desc_en: A Baroque stone gateway still cracked; scrolls and capitals remain. Sparse winter trees, grey-blue sky—ruins keeping time in the relief.

desc_zh: 暮紫冰面映着天空，一群水鸟静立中央。远岸树影与一点灯火，冷色把湖写成最短的诗。
desc_en: Dusk-purple ice mirrors the sky; waterfowl stand still at center. Distant treeline and one faint light—cool tones writing the lake as a short poem.

desc_zh: 琉璃黄瓦层层叠起，彩画斗拱细密。白石栏杆与狮影在侧，阴天把宫殿托得更静。
desc_en: Glazed yellow tiles stack in layers; painted brackets dense below. White balustrade and a lion fragment aside—overcast making the palace quieter still.

desc_zh: 仰拍白石螭首斜向远去，屋檐阴影压着。石面水痕与岁月同在，龙口把雨水的故事留下。
desc_en: Looking up, white marble dragon heads recede in a diagonal; eaves cast shade. Water stains share the stone with years—dragon mouths keeping the story of rain.

desc_zh: 前景栏杆虚化，「太和殿」蓝底金字清晰。香炉剪影与黄瓦同框，抬头便是中轴最沉的一刻。
desc_en: Blurred balustrades in front; the blue plaque “Taihe Dian” reads gold and clear. Incense burners and yellow tiles share the frame—looking up to the axis’s heaviest moment.

desc_zh: 高处俯看神武门与黄瓦长廊，雾把城郭抹淡。红墙金顶层层远去，古今叠在同一道灰白空气里。
desc_en: From above, Shenwumen and yellow-tiled halls; mist softens the city. Red walls and golden roofs recede—past and present layered in the same grey air.

desc_zh: 三重蓝琉璃瓦抬向金顶，「祈年殿」匾额居中。白石栏上人影很小，天空留白，殿把颜色留给自己。
desc_en: Triple blue glazed eaves lift to a golden finial; the plaque “Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests” sits center. Tiny figures on white marble—sky left blank, color kept for the hall.

desc_zh: 灰石尖塔刺向晴空，岩壁与松枝切入画面。乐园里的城堡，被拍成一段干净的仰望。
desc_en: Grey stone spires pierce clear sky; cliff and pine enter the frame. A theme-park castle, shot as a clean upward glance.

desc_zh: 哥特式楼宇贴着浅灰岩壁，蓝天占去大半空白。对角线构图把高度拉长，虚构成了可仰望的风景。
desc_en: Gothic towers cling to pale cliff; blue sky takes most of the blank. A diagonal stretches the height—fiction made into a view you can look up to.

desc_zh: 石屋陡顶覆着厚雪，冰柱垂下。巷口人影冬装簇拥，晴空把童话小镇照得很冷、很亮。
desc_en: Steep stone roofs hold thick snow; icicles hang. Winter coats crowd the alley mouth—clear sky lighting a fairy-tale village cold and bright.

desc_zh: 「小黄人乐园」蓝牌立在晴空下，黄人偶攀着边框。棕榈叶切入，游乐园把热闹做成一块干净的仰拍。
desc_en: A blue “Minion Land” sign under clear sky; yellow figures climb the frame. Palm fronds cut in—the park turning noise into one clean upward shot.

desc_zh: 多层岩壁上，水如薄纱垂落，苔藓贴着石缝。无人入画，只剩湿冷与绿，像山把声音压得很低。
desc_en: Across tiered rock, water falls like thin gauze; moss fills the seams. No one in frame—only damp cold and green, as if the mountain kept its voice low.

desc_zh: 牛仔外套的人回眸，石阶与栏杆在前。身后水帘虚化，旅途在台阶上留下一个短暂的停顿。
desc_en: In a denim jacket, looking back; stone steps and railing ahead. The waterfall softens behind—a brief pause the journey leaves on the stairs.

desc_zh: 侧身回望镜头，苔石栏杆切入近景。瀑水层叠在后，蓝与绿把这一程收成半身肖像。
desc_en: Turned in profile toward the lens; a mossy stone rail cuts the near ground. Layered falls behind—blue and green gathering the journey into a half-length portrait.

title_en: A Moment on the Mountain Steps
desc_zh: 手插口袋回望，细瀑贴着苔壁。石阶向上，表情平静，像把瀑布当成背景板。
desc_en: Hand in pocket, looking back; a slender fall hugs mossy cliff. Steps rise, expression calm—as if the waterfall were only a backdrop.

desc_zh: 近摄层叠水帘，滴珠与苔藓同框。暗石托着白亮，山里的一刻不必宏大，只要清楚。
desc_en: Close on layered curtains of water; droplets and moss share the frame. Dark stone holds white brightness—a mountain moment that need not be grand, only clear.

desc_zh: 斜向岩层占满画面，灰与浅褐交错。风化沟槽像时间的笔迹，静奢有时只是一块石头。
desc_en: Diagonal strata fill the frame; grey and pale brown interlace. Weathered grooves like handwriting of time—quiet luxury, sometimes, is only a rock.

desc_zh: 人立在铁链栏杆后微笑，白瀑铺满背景。红丝带系在桩上，水声很大，表情却很轻。
desc_en: Smiling behind chain railing; white falls fill the backdrop. Red ribbons tie the posts—the water loud, the expression light.

desc_zh: 牛仔外套靠着铁链，神情平静。身后水雾成墙，红结点缀，人与瀑保持刚好的距离。
desc_en: Denim jacket against the chain, expression calm. Mist walls the background, red knots as accents—person and falls at just the right distance.

desc_zh: 前景暗岩斜切，白水飞溅清晰。苔与蕨贴着湿壁，力量被收成一小片纹理。
desc_en: Dark rock cuts the foreground; white splash reads sharp. Moss and ferns cling to wet wall—force gathered into a small field of texture.

desc_zh: 水从上层倾泻，中台溅雾，下缘铺开。枝叶虚在边缘，森林把瀑布托成一段干净的白。
desc_en: Water pours from above, mist on the mid shelf, spreading at the lower rim. Soft foliage frames the edge—the forest holding the fall as a clean white stretch.

desc_zh: 厚苔岩檐下，水珠成帘垂落。暗处见绿，绿处见亮，一处被忽略的细节成了主角。
desc_en: Under a thick mossy overhang, droplets fall like a bead curtain. Green in the dark, light in the green—a overlooked detail taking the lead.

desc_zh: 蹲在「园内吸烟」牌前，烟与茶在手。红砖地与树篱之后是绿，旅途里也有这样不修饰的片刻。
desc_en: Squatting by a “smoking allowed” sign, cigarette and tea in hand. Red tile underfoot, greenery beyond the fence—an unstyled pause inside the journey.

desc_zh: 牛仔外套靠着木栏微笑，针叶浓密压顶。栈道木色温热，林荫把表情收得很轻。
desc_en: Smiling against a wood rail in denim; dense needles press overhead. Warm boardwalk timber—shade in the forest keeping the expression soft.

desc_zh: 蓝高领与浅蓝牛仔，手臂搭在木栏。背后针叶虚成墨绿，目光平直，像把森林当成房间。
desc_en: Blue turtleneck under light denim, arm on the wood rail. Needles soft dark green behind; gaze level—as if the forest were a room.

desc_zh: 侧身倚栏望向林深处，栈道弯向远方。针叶带露，色调偏冷，这一程停在安静的侧面。
desc_en: In profile, leaning on the rail toward deep trees; the boardwalk bends away. Dew on needles, cool tones—the journey pausing on a quiet side face.

title_en: A Spot of Orange on Wet Stone
desc_zh: 红褐色石板路微微反光，弯入密林。冷杉与湿气压得很低，深处有一点橘红衣影向前走，像把尺度忽然量给了整片绿。
desc_en: Wet reddish stone pavers curve into dense firs. Soft mist holds the canopy low; a small figure in orange walks ahead, suddenly giving the forest a human scale.

desc_zh: 浅溪沿暗石台层层跌落，白线细密，苔草贴在岩沿。两岸深绿收得很紧，水声像把整条谷压成一条窄而干净的节奏。
desc_en: A shallow creek spills over dark stone ledges in thin white sheets, moss clinging to each lip. Dense green banks close in, turning the valley into one quiet, measured rhythm.

desc_zh: 湿透的红褐石径直伸进林深处，两侧针叶垂得很低。没有行人，只有路面上的天光，静得像一场刚停的雨。
desc_en: A rain-darkened reddish path runs deep into evergreens, needles hanging low. Empty of people, the stones hold only sky-glow—quiet as rain just ended.

title_en: A Blue Bike on the Autumn Bend
desc_zh: 沥青小径在秋色里转弯，白衣骑手推着一辆青绿单车缓缓前行。金黄枝叶占满画面上方，像把午后轻轻框住。
desc_en: An asphalt path bends through autumn; a rider in white guides a turquoise bike along the curve. Golden foliage fills the upper frame and softens the afternoon.

desc_zh: 一排水杉沿岸排开，针叶烧成锈橙。近处水草静立，远岸有人散步，高楼只在灰白天际里淡淡一笔。
desc_en: A row of dawn redwoods lines the bank in rust-orange. Reeds stand still in the foreground; walkers mark the far lawn, towers only a pale note on the grey horizon.

desc_zh: 人背对镜头，站在厚厚的银杏叶上。树干细高，金黄顶冠叠成一层天棚，蓝夹克成了整片秋色里唯一的冷调。
desc_en: Seen from behind, a figure stands on a thick carpet of ginkgo leaves. Slender trunks lift a golden canopy; a blue jacket is the only cool note in the autumn field.

desc_zh: 两侧水杉排成纵深，锈橙针叶筛下光斑。木栏在左，行人与拍照的人沿路散开，午后被拉成一条长而暖的走廊。
desc_en: Twin rows of dawn redwoods stretch into depth, rust needles filtering light. A wooden rail runs left; walkers and a phone photographer scatter the warm corridor of afternoon.

desc_zh: 前景叶片虚成绿框，运河贴着锈红水杉向前延伸。远处拱桥与行人很小，整条岸线像被季节整齐排过一遍。
desc_en: Blurred leaves frame a canal that runs beside a line of rust-red dawn redwoods. A distant arch bridge and small figures keep the bank orderly and seasonal.

desc_zh: 水杉斜切画面，铜红与青绿并排。浅水照出树干，石岸微青，远处一点红衣把纵深轻轻钉住。
desc_en: Dawn redwoods cut diagonally in copper and green. Shallow water mirrors the trunks; a mossy embankment and a distant red figure quietly pin the depth.

desc_zh: 斜阳拉长影子，黑衣人牵着两只金毛走过红褐步道。头顶银杏黄得透亮，楼侧灰梯只作背景。
desc_en: Low sun stretches shadows as a figure in black walks two golden retrievers along a reddish path. Ginkgo leaves glow overhead; a grey stair is only backdrop.

desc_zh: 红褐步道上人影疏落，童帽一抹红。树影横铺路面，黄绿枝叶交叠成廊，午后被慢慢走散。
desc_en: Sparse figures move along a reddish lakeside path, a child’s red hat bright in the light. Tree shadows stripe the ground beneath a yellow-green canopy.

desc_zh: 蓝牛仔外套的人背对镜头举相机，前方是笔直的秋树大道。树干刷白，橙褐叶幕把路收成一条暖的视线。
desc_en: A figure in a denim jacket lifts a camera toward a straight avenue of autumn trees. Whitewashed trunks and an orange canopy draw the eye down a warm corridor.

desc_zh: 前景虚化的侧脸与牛仔外套，背后是整齐的水杉秋列。白漆树干与锈橙针叶把公园午后压得很静。
desc_en: A softly blurred profile in denim sits against a ranked autumn avenue of dawn redwoods. Whitewashed trunks and rust needles keep the afternoon still.

desc_zh: 水杉夹道的锈橙顶棚下，有人背影远去，有人迎面走来。浅色步道被树影轻轻切开，像一段不紧不慢的日常旅程。
desc_en: Under a rust-orange canopy of dawn redwoods, some walk away while others approach. Soft tree-shadows cut the pale path into an unhurried stretch of day.

desc_zh: 近岭暗，远峰亮，雪白顶线贴着碎云。蓝天干净，谷底有一点聚落，高处风像把画面擦过一遍。
desc_en: Near ridges stay dark while distant peaks lift bright snow under scattered cloud. A clear blue sky and a tiny valley settlement keep the high air crisp.

desc_zh: 蓝帽旅人背对镜头，红衣系在腰间，木杖点地。眼前是层层蓝岭与雪顶，风从开阔处直接灌过来。
desc_en: A hooded traveler faces the range, red jacket at the waist, wooden staff grounded. Layered blue ridges and snow peaks open under a clear, windy sky.

desc_zh: 人站在前景低处，蓝橙背包与腰间红衣醒目。雪峰贴着碎云横开，脚下灌木把高度悄悄托住。
desc_en: From a low foreground, a traveler faces snow peaks under scattered cloud—blue-orange pack and a red jacket at the waist marking the quiet scale of height.

desc_zh: 稍低的机位托起背影，雪峰与蓝天占满上方。木杖、水壶与红衣腰结，把一场高处停留写得很轻。
desc_en: A low angle lifts a traveler’s back against snow peaks and open blue. Staff, bottle, and a red waist-tie keep the high pause understated.

desc_zh: 干草坡与护栏弯道在右，远处分层蓝岭托起雪白主峰。观景处有极小的人影，天空干净得近乎空。
desc_en: Dry grass and a guardrailed bend sit right; blue ridges stack toward a bright snow massif. Tiny figures at a lookout hold the clear sky’s scale.

desc_zh: 沥青弯道贴着金褐草坡，谷底有白屋聚落。远峰戴雪，云贴峰腰，整片蓝被拉开成一层层远近。
desc_en: An asphalt bend hugs a tawny slope; white roofs cluster in the valley. Snow peaks and mid-ridge cloud pull the blues into layered distance.

desc_zh: 银护栏切过前景草坡，一辆浅色车很小。雪脉横贯天际，低云贴峰，高原的白与蓝被路轻轻引开。
desc_en: A silver rail cuts the foreground grass; a pale vehicle is tiny. A continuous snow range and low cloud hold the plateau’s blue and white.

title_en: Distant Peaks from the Grass Slope
desc_zh: 黄褐草坡与深绿灌丛铺在近处，弯道护栏在右。中景蓝岭叠出，主峰戴雪，碎云贴着脊线。
desc_en: Tawny grass and dark shrubs fill the near slope; a rail curves right. Blue ridges stack toward a snow-capped crest under thin cloud.

desc_zh: 重云压顶，山岭层层退成蓝。谷底聚落极小，雪峰在云隙里亮起，像把整段路程抬高了一截。
desc_en: Heavy cloud presses down while ridges fall back in blue. A tiny valley settlement sits below; snow peaks flare through breaks in the sky.

desc_zh: 近岭暗青，中景化成一层层青蓝，远峰戴雪白。丝状云横过天际，山谷安静得只剩颜色在退。
desc_en: Near ridges stay dark; mid ranges dissolve into layered blue before snow crests. Wispy cloud stretches the sky while the valleys stay still.

desc_zh: 低处暗岭与亮谷并置，中段白云横截，远方雪峰浮起。天空饱和，风景被切成冷暖两层。
desc_en: Dark near ridges and a lit valley sit below a horizontal cloud belt; snow peaks float beyond. Saturated sky divides the scene into cool and bright.

desc_zh: 厚云滤过的光落在远峰雪线上，近坡暗绿，谷底有细路与屋影。蓝被压成一种沉静的远。
desc_en: Filtered light touches distant snow while near slopes stay dark green; a thin road and roofs mark the valley. Blue settles into a quiet distance.

desc_zh: 近处针叶林脊纹理清楚，远山化成淡蓝雾带。电塔极小，天空丝云横过，像一场高处的长呼吸。
desc_en: A near conifer ridge holds sharp texture while farther ranges fade to pale blue haze. Tiny pylons and streaked cloud keep the high air long and open.

desc_zh: 前景土路与褐坡，中景蓝岭，远峰在云隙里被照亮。电塔沿坡而下，一场天气把旅程写得很戏剧。
desc_en: A dirt road and tawny slope lead into blue ridges; distant peaks flare through cloud breaks. Pylons descend the hillside as weather sharpens the journey.

desc_zh: 橙红云带压在地平，太阳半圆刚起。山下层峦成深蓝剪影，一天从暖与冷的交界线开始。
desc_en: Orange-red cloud bands the horizon as a half-disk of sun lifts. Layered ridges stay deep-blue silhouettes where warm and cool meet.

desc_zh: 丝状云染成桃橙，太阳贴着雾线升起。近岭深蓝，远岭更淡，整幅画只靠一条暖光带撑住。
desc_en: Wispy clouds turn peach and orange as the sun lifts along a haze line. Near ridges stay navy, farther ones pale—the warm band holds the frame.

title_en: Round Sun at the Pink-Blue Edge
desc_zh: 正圆太阳贴在薄云上，上方金橙，下方山海沉入粉紫与靛蓝。高处视野把黎明压成一条干净的色带。
desc_en: A round sun sits on thin cloud—gold above, mountains sinking into pink-violet and indigo below. Height reduces dawn to one clean band of color.

desc_zh: 暗云压顶，雪峰一线被橘金点亮，腰间缠着薄雾。冷调山谷衬出那几分钟的暖，像一天里最短的庆典。
desc_en: Dark cloud above, a line of snow peaks lit gold-orange, mist at their waists. Cool valleys frame those few warm minutes like a brief rite of day.

title_en: Gilded Crests Above the Cloud Belt
desc_zh: 雪峰受光成金，云带横切峰腰，前景暗岭沉默。电塔极小，只为证明这片静有多大。
desc_en: Snow crests turn gold while a cloud belt cuts the mid-slope; near ridges stay dark. Tiny pylons only prove how wide the quiet runs.

desc_zh: 近山全黑，中脊残雪，远峰被低日照成金白。深蓝天空与细云横过，黄昏把最高处单独留亮。
desc_en: Near mountains go black; mid ridges hold residual snow while far peaks catch gold-white light. Deep blue sky and thin cloud leave only the highest lit.

desc_zh: 多层混凝土桥身贴着山腰转弯，一辆白车很小。谷底浅河与冷杉，远方雪峰在蓝天下，路像把旅程悬在半空。
desc_en: A multi-tier concrete viaduct curves the mountainside; one white car is tiny. A shallow river and firs below, snow peaks under blue—the road holds the journey mid-air.

desc_zh: 干河床在谷心蜿蜒，两侧冷杉与褐坡夹持。远峰戴雪，前景针叶虚成框，像从高处把一程慢慢看完。
desc_en: A dry riverbed winds the valley floor between firs and brown slopes. Snow peaks ahead, out-of-focus needles frame the view like a long look from above.

desc_zh: 褐橙草坡上盘山路急转，谷心阴影深。远峰戴雪，丝云横过蓝天，路把整片高原轻轻拉开。
desc_en: Switchbacks cut a rust-brown slope into a shadowed valley. Snow ridges and streaked cloud open under blue—the road quietly stretches the plateau.

desc_zh: 灰路在荒坡上画出 S 形，几辆浅色车极小。远方雪顶亮起，卷云铺满上半幅，旅程被写进弯里。
desc_en: A grey S-bend climbs arid slopes; pale cars are tiny. Distant snow flares under stretched cloud—the journey lives inside the curve.

desc_zh: 灰褐高原上，浅水洼旁站着极小的人影。雪峰贴着低云横贯，天空苍白，尺度被风重新量过。
desc_en: Tiny figures stand by a shallow pool on grey-brown highland. Snow ridges run under low cloud; a pale sky recalibrates the scale.

desc_zh: 细木栏沿坡蜿蜒，浅水映着灰天。雪峰与薄雾贴在天际，一个人影把整片空旷轻轻钉住。
desc_en: A thin rail climbs the slope past a sky-reflecting pool. Snow peaks and mist hold the horizon; one small figure pins the emptiness.

title_en: Snow Peaks at the V-Valley End
desc_zh: 两侧暗坡收成深 V，谷底细路与小屋极小。雪峰顶着厚云，冷色把高度压得很近。
desc_en: Dark slopes close into a deep V; a thin road and tiny roofs sit below. Snow peaks press under heavy cloud, cold tones shrinking the height.

desc_zh: 近处两翼暗林下压，谷底红顶小屋极小。中景雪峰亮起，厚云压顶，像把旅程收进一条窄缝。
desc_en: Dark forested flanks press in; a tiny red roof sits in the valley floor. Mid-frame snow crests light under heavy cloud—the journey fits a narrow seam.

desc_zh: 条纹衫的人抱臂望向远山，湖面静得映出树影。两只黑天鹅划过，对岸屋檐与薄雾山峦把午后托得很轻。
desc_en: Arms crossed, a figure in stripes looks toward hazy mountains. Two black swans glide the still lake; far roofs and misted ridges hold the afternoon lightly.

desc_zh: 侧脸与条纹毛衣贴着湖岸，一树深红枫叶在右。远山含雾，水面灰蓝，颜色被压成一种安静的对比。
desc_en: A profile in a striped sweater stands by the lake; a deep-red maple flares right. Misty mountains and grey-blue water keep the contrast quiet.

desc_zh: 灰瓦坡顶与玻璃立面贴着湖岸，拱桥连起草坪。远山含云，倒影完整，像把一座静奢的午后铺平。
desc_en: Grey-tiled roofs and glass façades line the lake; an arched bridge joins the lawns. Cloud-soft mountains mirror cleanly—a quiet afternoon laid flat.

desc_zh: 木拱桥横过窄水，岸上深绿与坡顶屋舍齐整。有人缓步，远山淡蓝，整片绿被湖面轻轻接住。
desc_en: A wooden arch spans narrow water beside deep green lawns and tiled roofs. Slow walkers, pale-blue mountains—the lake quietly catches all the green.

desc_zh: 灌满水的田埂弯成银白，绿树与白花点在岸上。远处楼影含雾，田里的倒影把天空放得很低。
desc_en: Flooded paddies bend into silver; green trees and white blossom mark the banks. Distant buildings haze away while reflections pull the sky down low.

title_en: Looking Back on the Forest Road
desc_zh: 沥青弯道旁，条纹衫的人回眸一笑。身后山坡层层绿树，路缘草坪整齐，像一段刚开始的山行。
desc_en: On a curving asphalt road, a figure in stripes glances back with a soft smile. Layered green slopes and a tidy verge open a mountain walk just begun.

desc_zh: 人立在弯道左侧回望，深绿林海占满上半幅。薄雾贴着山顶，步调被放慢成一张安静的肖像。
desc_en: Standing left of the bend, a traveler looks back; deep forest fills the upper frame. Mist softens the summit, slowing the pace into a quiet portrait.

desc_zh: 青绿幼树排成一道墙，人沿灰路迎面走来。远山深绿含雾，条纹与茶色把山行穿成很轻的日常。
desc_en: Young green trees form a wall as a traveler approaches on grey asphalt. Misty dark slopes and earthy stripes keep the mountain day understated.

desc_zh: 人抬手至额，身后是雾蓝山体与亮绿树列。软光把轮廓托住，像把山里的一瞬按成慢动作。
desc_en: A hand lifts to the brow against mist-blue mountain and bright green trees. Soft light holds the outline—one mountain moment slowed.

title_en: Yellow Blooms on the Stream Rock
desc_zh: 人坐在苔石上，掌心抛起几点黄瓣。浅溪与深绿林在身后，像把山中午后收成一枚轻巧的瞬间。
desc_en: Seated on mossy stone, a hand tosses yellow petals into soft air. A shallow stream and deep forest gather the mountain afternoon into one light beat.

desc_zh: 手机举到眼前，遮住面容；身后是石滩浅溪与层层绿叶。记录本身成为画面，旅程被再拍一遍。
desc_en: A phone lifts to eye level, hiding the face; behind, a rocky creek and layered green. The act of recording becomes the frame—the journey shot again.

desc_zh: 人半侧身回望，手机垂在手边，苔石与清流铺开。绿叶垂顶，笑容很淡，像把湿润的山林留住一瞬。
desc_en: Half-turned on mossy stones, phone at the side, clear water running past. Leaves hang overhead; a slight smile keeps the damp forest for a beat.

desc_zh: 背影侧过，目光抬向树冠，溪石在脚下排开。深绿把路收窄，山行停在一处很静的岸边。
desc_en: A side-back stance looks up into canopy; creek stones spread underfoot. Deep green narrows the path—the walk pauses on a quiet bank.

desc_zh: 灰石铺满溪床，水面映着绿冠。右岸树干细密，左缘露一点灰路，无人，只有水声被想象出来。
desc_en: Grey stones fill the creek bed, water mirroring the canopy. Slender trunks crowd the right; a hint of grey path left—empty, only the sound of water implied.

desc_zh: 清流绕着深灰卵石转弯，苔斑贴在岩面。前景溅起一点白，深处绿荫收紧，像一条很小的山程。
desc_en: Clear water bends around dark grey boulders, moss on the rock. A little white splash ahead, green shade closing in—a small mountain course.

desc_zh: 厚苔覆住左侧大石，一线银水贴着岩缝下行。近处一棵幼苗探出，湿润被收成极小的景。
desc_en: Thick moss coats the left boulder; a silver rill slips the crevice. A tiny seedling leans out—dampness framed as a miniature scene.

desc_zh: 细高树干立在弯道旁，深绿灌丛贴着路边。灰路轻轻转弯，整片绿被软光洗成一种干净的静。
desc_en: Slender trunks stand by a soft bend; deep hedges line the verge. Grey asphalt turns lightly—soft light rinses the green into clean quiet.

desc_zh: 深红枫叶压在前景，虚化的浅溪与绿岸退后。暖与冷并置，像把山里一棵树单独点亮。
desc_en: Crimson maple fills the foreground; a soft-focus stream and green banks fall back. Warm against cool—one tree lit alone in the mountain.

title_en: Blue Peacock on the Log Rail
desc_zh: 钴蓝色颈羽贴着木栏，背景是木屋与绿叶虚影。姿态安静，颜色却把整片林子提亮一瞬。
desc_en: A cobalt neck grips a rustic log rail; cabin and green leaves blur behind. The pose is still—the color briefly lifts the whole wood.

desc_zh: 一朵全开的白瓣雏菊居中，蜜蜂停在黄心。绿叶虚成底，细小生命把夏日收成一帧。
desc_en: A full white daisy centers the frame; a bee rests on the yellow disk. Soft green bokeh holds a small life as one summer still.

desc_zh: 灰瓦檐下，「高桥里 UTOPIA」白字贴着土墙。人倚栏回望，露营椅露一点顶，山居被写成轻巧的停靠。
desc_en: Under grey tiles, white letters read Gaoqiaoli UTOPIA on an earthen wall. Leaning the rail, camping chairs peek below—a light mountain stop.

desc_zh: 人靠着细栏侧脸微笑，土墙与灰瓦占满背景。字样安静，像把一场山中落脚拍成肖像。
desc_en: Leaning a thin rail, a soft side smile; earthen wall and grey tiles fill the back. Quiet lettering turns a mountain stop into a portrait.

desc_zh: 木廊与夯土墙前，人侧身轻笑；「YE PO COFFEE」字样在后。远山含绿，一杯山中午后被留在门口。
desc_en: On a wooden porch by rammed earth, a soft side smile; YE PO COFFEE letters behind. Green mountains hold a mountain afternoon at the door.

desc_zh: 浓绿巨树占满上半幅，前景人影虚成茶色。手中一点粉花，远山淡蓝，尺度被树重新定义。
desc_en: A dense green giant fills the upper frame; a soft brown figure holds a pink bloom below. Pale-blue hills—the tree resets the scale.

title_en: Scent of a Flower Under the Tree
desc_zh: 前景虚化的人把紫花送到鼻前，巨树与灰石在后。草坡很浅，山风像把气味也拍进画面。
desc_en: A soft-focus figure lifts a purple flower to the face; giant tree and grey rock behind. Shallow grass—the mountain air seems to enter the frame.

title_en: A Pink Bloom Beneath the Canopy
desc_zh: 人立在草坡，粉花贴着面颊；身后双层绿冠高耸。灰石在侧，远山含雾，停顿被写得很轻。
desc_en: On the grass, a pink bloom at the cheek; a double green canopy towers behind. Grey rock aside, misty hills—the pause stays light.

desc_zh: 全身立在草坡，紫花送到鼻尖，巨树把人比得很小。远岭淡灰，目光向下，像把山中一刻收进花香。
desc_en: Full-length on the grass, a purple bloom at the nose; the giant tree shrinks the figure. Pale ridges, eyes down—one mountain beat kept in scent.

desc_zh: 双手握着一枝紫花，目光偏开；身后绿冠饱满。灰石在右，软光把肖像与风景叠成一层。
desc_en: Both hands hold a purple stem; the gaze turns aside under a full green canopy. Grey rock right—soft light layers portrait into landscape.

desc_zh: 人立在浅草上侧望，巨树与远山在后。条纹与茶色裙摆很克制，山居午后被收成一张清淡肖像。
desc_en: Standing in short grass, looking aside; giant tree and distant hills behind. Stripes and a brown skirt stay restrained—a pale mountain afternoon portrait.

desc_zh: 近处灰瓦亭廊贴着湖沿，对岸绿树与坡顶屋舍倒映完整。远山含云，一场静奢的山中停留铺开。
desc_en: A grey-tiled pavilion sits the near shore; opposite trees and roofs mirror cleanly. Cloud-soft mountains open a quiet mountain stay.

desc_zh: 半幅湖水映着灰瓦与绿树，远山淡蓝。天空高亮，倒影画家，像把行程按成一张横躺的明信片。
desc_en: Half the frame is lake mirroring grey roofs and green; mountains fade blue. High sky, painterly reflection—a journey laid flat like a postcard.

title_en: Lake and Bridge from the Pavilion Corner
desc_zh: 木亭一角入画，湖心映山，小拱桥连起草坪。远山含雾，人影极小，静被建筑轻轻框住。
desc_en: A pavilion corner enters the frame; the lake mirrors hills, a small arch joining lawns. Misty peaks, tiny figures—quiet framed by timber.

desc_zh: 整幅湖面反照山峦与岸树，右缘一点红枫。白伞与灰瓦贴岸，阴天把颜色压成干净的一层。
desc_en: The full lake mirrors peaks and shore trees; a red maple edges right. White umbrellas and grey roofs under overcast—colors pressed clean.

desc_zh: 岸上灰瓦与绿树齐整，湖心一只水禽划出细纹。远山层层蓝绿，静奢被一点涟漪轻轻打断。
desc_en: Grey roofs and green trees line the bank; one waterbird draws a thin wake. Layered blue-green mountains—quiet briefly broken by a ripple.

title_en: Yellow Bloom Bank and Mountain Shadow
desc_zh: 岸边黄花与深绿树丛贴水，远山倒映完整。木栈有人极小，阴天把整片山居洗得很亮。
desc_en: Yellow blooms and deep green hug the water; mountains mirror whole. Tiny figures on a wooden walk—overcast rinses the retreat bright.

desc_zh: 白伞与灰瓦隐在树间，湖面平得映出峰影。右岸黄花与石埠，有人站立，山被雾染成蓝绿。
desc_en: White umbrellas and grey roofs hide in trees; the lake mirrors peaks flat. Yellow blooms and a stone pier—figures stand, mountains misted blue-green.

desc_zh: 开阔湖面托起岸上坡顶与绿树，远岭层层退开。软白天空，几个人影沿路很慢，像把山程放成横幅。
desc_en: A wide lake holds tiled roofs and green; ridges fall back in layers. Soft white sky, a few slow figures—the mountain course laid as a banner.

desc_zh: 云影落在近坡，一处草顶被阳光点成亮绿。远岭淡去，卷云堆起，高原把光切成一块块。
desc_en: Cloud shadow darkens the near slope while a grass summit turns lime in sun. Distant ridges fade under stacked cloud—the plateau cuts light into patches.

desc_zh: 层峦铺满浅绿与深绿，一块云影压在中脊。积云厚重，远峰含灰，风像在缓慢移动整幅画。
desc_en: Ridges of pale and deep green hold a cloud-shadow on the mid crest. Heavy cumulus, grey distant peaks—wind seems to shift the whole frame.

desc_zh: 黄绿草坡绵延，针叶斑块点在脊线。白云贴着远丘，天空干净，像一场没有人声的高原午后。
desc_en: Yellow-green slopes stretch on, conifer patches along the crest. White cloud sits the far hills under clean sky—a highland afternoon without voices.

desc_zh: 黑褐牦牛散在绿草间，细木栏横过中景。远山层叠，厚云压顶，高原日常被拍得很沉静。
desc_en: Dark yaks scatter the green; a thin wooden fence crosses mid-frame. Layered hills under heavy cloud—highland day kept quiet and deep.

title_en: A Beam on the Valley Slope
desc_zh: 厚云开缝，一道亮绿斜切谷坡，远处有细小畜影。土路在左下，阴晴把高原写成明暗两半。
desc_en: Clouds part; a bright green beam cuts the valley slope, tiny livestock afar. A dirt track lower left—sun and shade split the plateau in two.

title_en: Pale Track in the Valley Floor
desc_zh: S 形土路贴着细流，小屋贴着坡脚。云影斑驳，天空几乎全是白，旅程被收进谷线。
desc_en: An S-shaped pale track follows a thin stream; low roofs hug the foot of the slope. Mottled cloud shadow, a nearly white sky—the journey fits the valley line.

desc_zh: 沥青弯道贴着绿丘，电杆与一辆车很小。积云占满大半天空，云影在坡上移动，像把长途写进风里。
desc_en: Asphalt bends the green hills; poles and one car stay tiny. Cumulus fills most of the sky, shadows moving the slopes—a long road written into wind.

title_en: Small Settlement in the Deep Valley
desc_zh: 绒绿山浪层层叠起，谷底小屋与细路极小。云影切割坡面，蓝天碎开，尺度被草原重新量过。
desc_en: Velvet-green waves stack the hills; tiny roofs and a thin track sit the valley floor. Cloud shadow cuts the slopes under broken blue—the grassland resets scale.

title_en: A Patch of Sun on the Pasture
desc_zh: 阴云下，一道阳光铺亮黄屋与草坡，牦牛散点其间。公路与电杆在侧，光只停留很短的一瞬。
desc_en: Under cloud, one sun-patch lights ochre buildings and grass, yaks scattered through. Road and poles aside—the light stays only a brief moment.

title_en: Town at the Edge of Meadow
desc_zh: 低矮聚落贴着绿丘脚，前景草甸与浅水映天。积云饱满，畜影细小，高原把人居放得很轻。
desc_en: Low roofs hug the green foothills; meadow and shallow water mirror sky. Full cumulus, tiny livestock—the plateau keeps dwelling light.

desc_zh: 灰路贴着右侧谷缘，几汪冷色湖水嵌在岩原。远峰挂雪，厚云堆起，旅程被拉成一条竖向的远。
desc_en: A grey road hugs the right valley rim; cool alpine pools sit the rocky plain. Snow-streaked peaks under stacked cloud—the journey stretches vertical and far.

desc_zh: 公路沿湖转弯，三汪蓝绿湖水嵌在暗褐草甸。远峰锋利，云隙泻光，高原把颜色切得很干净。
desc_en: The highway bends lake-side; three blue-green pools sit dark meadow. Sharp peaks and light through cloud—the plateau cuts color clean.

title_en: Lakes and Road Under Snow Peaks
desc_zh: 雪峰横在远际，湖面映着云白，右缘公路极细。左下小屋贴岸，整幅高原像把一程慢慢摊开。
desc_en: Snow peaks hold the far line; lakes mirror cloud-white, a thin highway right. Low shelters left—the whole plateau slowly unfolds one journey.

desc_zh: 湖面呈淡青，近岸灌丛压在暗影里。对岸草甸窄窄一条，再往后是带雪的岩峰与层积云。风不大，水色静，山体的阴影把高处的冷意写得很清楚。
desc_en: Pale turquoise water fills the foreground, scrub dark along the near shore. A thin meadow sits before rocky peaks patched with snow and piled cumulus. Little wind; the quiet surface and mountain shade make the altitude feel sharp and still.

desc_zh: 从高处俯看，灰白碎石坡落入绿谷，一湾小湖嵌在右侧洼地。柏油路从左下弯进画面，一辆红色小车在路上，把山谷的尺度一下子拉开。
desc_en: From above, scree slopes drop into a green basin where a small alpine pond rests on the right. An asphalt road curves in from the lower left; a lone red vehicle on it stretches the valley to its true scale.

desc_zh: 两座岩峰一冷一暖并立，碎石坡垂直的冲刷线很清晰。谷底公路自右下蜿蜒而来，路边几点白帐。云影压在主峰一侧，明暗把山形切得很干净。
desc_en: Two rocky peaks stand side by side—one cool grey, one warmer tan—with clear erosion lines on the scree. A road winds up from the lower right past a few white shelters. Cloud shadow on the main summit cuts the forms clean.

desc_zh: 远山层叠，色调偏灰绿与浅褐；近处草坡上一道土路急转折返。厚云铺满天顶，光是散的，山谷深处的针叶林被压成深色带。
desc_en: Layered ridges fade into grey-green and pale brown. In the near slope a pale dirt road makes a sharp switchback. Thick cloud softens the light; conifers in the deep valleys read as a dark band.

desc_zh: 前景是密密的黄花与绿草，焦点落在花甸深处。中景有几丛松与大石，再往后是灰褐岩峰。蓝天白云干净，近处柔焦把距离拉得很开。
desc_en: Yellow wildflowers crowd the foreground grass, focus settling deeper in the meadow. Pines and boulders hold the middle; a grey-tan peak rises beyond. Clear blue sky; soft front blur opens the distance.

desc_zh: 俯看一整片牧场式草甸，土路与浅溪并排蜿蜒。针叶树疏密错落，远山层层叠绿。天空偏白，光很软，几处小屋像针尖一样落在谷里。
desc_en: A high view over rolling pasture: a dirt track and a shallow stream wander together. Conifers scatter, then gather on the steeper slopes. Pale sky, soft light; a few tiny shelters pin the valley floor.

desc_zh: 竖构图里，下方是平顶建筑的小聚落，草坡起伏，阳光斑驳。上方岩峰覆厚雪，顶上压着暗云。人影极小，山的体量因此更沉。
desc_en: In a vertical frame, flat-roofed buildings sit in a green fold of hills under broken light. Above, rocky peaks hold heavy snow beneath dark cloud. A tiny figure makes the mountain mass feel absolute.

desc_zh: 一匹浅白马低头吃草，红缰绳拖在地上。背后是起伏绿丘与覆雪岩峰，厚云压顶。马很小，山很大，安静却不冷清。
desc_en: A pale horse grazes with its head down, a thin red lead trailing on the grass. Rolling green hills lead to snow-capped crags under heavy cloud. Small horse, large mountain—quiet without emptiness.

desc_zh: 灰白天空下，一座缓坡占满下半幅。坡顶偏左只有一棵深绿树，轮廓清楚。草与浅褐土斑驳，近处再有几丛矮灌。画面几乎只剩线条与留白。
desc_en: Under a flat grey-white sky, a soft hill fills the lower half. One dark evergreen sits alone near the crest, slightly left. Mottled grass and earth, a few low shrubs below—little more than line and empty air.

desc_zh: 花草坡上，几匹鞍马低头吃草，两个人影一立一蹲。远山被低云罩住，色调灰绿。旅途里的停顿，不喧哗，只留下皮具与织毯的一点颜色。
desc_en: On a flowered slope, saddled horses graze while two figures stand and crouch. Distant ridges sit under low cloud in muted greens. A pause on the trail—quiet, with only saddle cloths for color.

desc_zh: 灰白马、棕马与一匹深色马的后半身，在黄白小花间吃草。一人背对镜头坐着望山。远丘层层入云，鞍毯的红与蓝是画面里最醒目的暖意。
desc_en: A grey-white horse, a brown one, and the rear of a dark bay graze among yellow and white flowers. Someone sits facing the hills. Ridges stack into cloud; red and blue saddle cloths hold the only warm accents.

desc_zh: 近处草丘柔和，中景针叶林成片，左坡露出浅灰岩壁。远峰被厚云压住，谷口有雾气。没有人影，只剩绿与灰的层层推进。
desc_en: Soft grass ridges in front; dense conifers fill the mid valley; pale rock shows on the left slope. Thick cloud sits on the far peaks, mist in the pass. No figures—only green and grey advancing in layers.

title_en: Leading a Horse Across the Ridge
desc_zh: 草坡斜切画面，坡顶一人牵着红棕马缓行。黄花点在近处草间，大半幅是白亮的低云。人与马只占一线，旅途被缩成一个剪影。
desc_en: A grassy slope cuts diagonally; on the crest a figure leads a reddish-brown horse. Yellow flowers dot the near grass; bright low cloud fills most of the frame. Person and horse become a thin silhouette of the journey.

title_en: Lone Tree Below the Cloud Band
desc_zh: 草甸向下倾斜，底部一棵深色孤树，旁有极小的人影。山腰一道白云横过，上缘是暗紫山脊。土路细细绕开，像随手画的线。
desc_en: The meadow drops away to a single dark tree and a tiny figure beside it. A white cloud band cuts the mountainside; purple-dark ridges sit above. Thin dirt tracks curve like drawn lines.

desc_zh: 深绿草坡斜切，小径上几个骑者缩成黑点。后山岩峰被白雾缠住，天色近灰。路在坡上折了一下，人与雾几乎要融在一起。
desc_en: A deep-green slope fills the lower frame; a few riders shrink to dark points on the path. Rock peaks behind are wrapped in white mist under a pale grey sky. The trail bends once—figures and fog nearly merge.

desc_zh: 一层层绿丘向远退，阳光打在中景山脊上，松树成点状剪影。近处阴影较深，远山偏蓝紫，厚云压着天顶。明暗交界把山形推得很远。
desc_en: Green ridges recede; sunlight catches a midground crest where pines stand as dark dots. Near slopes sit in deeper shade, far hills turn blue-violet under thick cloud. The light edge pushes the landscape far.

desc_zh: 绿坡上一条细土路，左下有穿亮黄外套的行人。后方岩峰与雪线被雾气遮住大半，天色白茫。一点高亮衣色，整幅山才有了尺度。
desc_en: A thin dirt path crosses the green slope; lower left, a walker in a bright yellow jacket. Rocky peaks and snow behind dissolve into mist under a white sky. That one high note of color sets the mountain’s scale.

desc_zh: 前景大片绿丘，小路蜿蜒，几棵矮树点缀。左后方雪峰明亮，白云贴着山腰，头顶蓝天开朗。阴天之后的这一口气，山色一下子透亮。
desc_en: A broad green hill fills the front, a faint path winding past a few small trees. Left rear, a snow peak brightens; white cloud hugs the mid-slope under clear blue. After grey weather, the mountain suddenly breathes light.

desc_zh: 近处草丘柔软起伏，像铺了一层绒。远方岩峰锋利，灰蓝交界。厚白云铺满上沿，光均匀，几乎没有硬影。静，却不空。
desc_en: Near hills roll soft and velvet-green. Beyond, jagged peaks rise in slate and pale blue. Thick white cloud fills the upper frame; even light, almost no hard shadow. Still—without emptiness.

desc_zh: 下是平滑绿丘，中是锋利岩脊，上是厚云。右上留出一小片淡蓝。草坡有浅浅的侵蚀纹路，山石的灰褐与绿形成克制的对比。
desc_en: Smooth green hills below, sharp rock ridges in the middle, heavy cloud above. A small patch of pale blue opens upper right. Soft erosion lines on the grass; grey-brown stone against green—quiet contrast.

desc_zh: 双车道柏油路呈 S 形爬升，黄线白线清晰，路面有横向减速标线。几辆车疏落地往前开，两侧是绿褐草坡与远山。竖幅把「还要走很久」说得很直白。
desc_en: A two-lane road climbs in an S-curve, yellow and white lines clean, rumble strips across the asphalt. A few cars spaced far apart; green-brown slopes and distant peaks on both sides. The vertical frame says plainly: a long way yet.

desc_zh: 绿谷里一小片聚落，前方白塔金顶，旁有赭红墙与金瓦建筑。柏油路弯进村口，背后山丘起伏，头顶积云很大。远看像嵌在草甸里的一小块安静。
desc_en: A small settlement in a green valley: a white stupa with a golden finial, ochre walls and a golden roof nearby. Asphalt curves to the entrance; hills rise behind under large cumulus. From afar it reads as a quiet patch set into the meadow.

desc_zh: 草坡斜切，脊线上一座扁平现代建筑，深灰与浅米色墙面，开窗冷静。右上留出一块蓝天，其余是厚白云。房子很小，像被山坡轻轻托住。
desc_en: A grassy slope cuts the frame; on the ridge a low modern building—charcoal and beige, windows cool and sparse. A patch of blue opens upper right among thick white cloud. The house sits small, lightly held by the hill.

desc_zh: 近处公路横过灌丛草甸，中景山丘有畜群与电塔。远方山脉上方，乌云垂下一道雨幕。色调偏深绿与石蓝，旅途里天气忽然变沉的一瞬间。
desc_en: A paved road crosses shrub meadow; mid hills hold livestock and a power pylon. Far ranges sit under dark cloud, a rain curtain falling. Deep greens and slate blues—the moment weather turns heavy on the road.

desc_zh: U 形深谷向前延伸，近处柏油路呈 S 弯，几辆白车很小。两侧草坡与针叶林夹着干河床，左坡有一排白塔电杆。蓝天白云，光把山形切得很清楚。
desc_en: A deep U-valley stretches ahead; an S-curve of asphalt holds a few tiny white cars. Grass and conifers flank a rocky streambed; white pylons march the left slope. Blue sky, white cumulus—light carving the ridges clean.

desc_zh: 右侧一人侧身望向左方，蓝外套，手持长焦相机。身后是青绿湖水与锯齿岩峰，积云贴着山顶。人与山并置，尺度一下拉开。
desc_en: On the right a figure stands in profile, blue jacket, long lens in hand, looking left. Behind: turquoise water and jagged peaks under piled cumulus. Person and mountain side by side—scale opens at once.

desc_zh: 竖幅里，蓝外套旅人低头看相机，左手插袋。背后湖水青绿，岩峰与积云占满上半幅。表情安静，像刚按下快门后的那一秒。
desc_en: Vertical: a traveler in a blue jacket looks down at the camera, one hand in a pocket. Turquoise water behind; rock peaks and cumulus fill the upper half. A quiet second just after the shutter.

desc_zh: 蓝外套旅人举起手机，屏幕上是海拔表，红圈写着 4925m。背后岩峰陡立，绿谷与碎石坡铺开。数字不大，山却很大。
desc_en: A traveler in a blue jacket holds up a phone—altimeter dial reading 4925 m in red. Behind, a steep rock peak rises over green valley and scree. The number is small; the mountain is not.

desc_zh: 人仰躺在黄白小花的草甸里，遮阳帽遮住脸，右手拈着一朵黄花。灰石散落，天光柔和。旅途里难得的彻底放松。
desc_en: Someone lies back in a meadow of yellow and white flowers, face under a bucket hat, a yellow bloom in the right hand. Grey rocks scattered; soft daylight. A rare, complete pause on the road.

desc_zh: 前景黄花虚成色块，中景草丘明暗斑驳，主峰覆雪，顶上压着暗云。冷暖对冲：近处热闹，远处沉默。
desc_en: Yellow blooms blur into color in front; mid hills patch with light and shade; the main peak holds snow under a dark cloud. Warm near, cold far—noise of flowers against a silent summit.

desc_zh: 下方小聚落与车辆，草甸有深色畜影。中景绿丘被云影切成明暗块，上端雪峰厚重。竖构图把「住在山脚下」说得很清楚。
desc_en: A small settlement and vehicles below; a dark animal in the meadow. Mid hills break into sun and shadow; snow peaks weigh the top. Vertical frame: living under the mountain, plainly.

desc_zh: 近处草甸柔和，一线深色针叶林标出谷缘。V 形深谷向远收束，远峰灰蓝，云雾贴脊。光散，绿意被压得很沉静。
desc_en: Soft meadow in front; a dark conifer line marks the valley rim. A V-shaped gorge draws inward to blue-grey peaks with mist on the ridges. Diffused light—greens held quiet and deep.

desc_zh: 中景一人背对镜头坐着，浅色帽，望向深谷。近处黄花虚焦，远山被低云罩住。人很小，像把整片山色当作一张长椅。
desc_en: Mid-frame, someone sits back to camera in a light hat, facing the deep valley. Yellow flowers soft in front; peaks under low cloud. Small figure—as if the whole landscape were a long bench.

desc_zh: 右下一人坐岩上望谷，谷底有一小簇红顶屋舍。土路细细绕下，针叶林与草甸分层。厚云压顶，静得像隔着一层纱。
desc_en: Lower right, a figure sits on rock overlooking the hollow—a cluster of red roofs below. Dirt tracks unwind; conifers and meadow layer the slopes. Thick cloud above; quiet as if seen through gauze.

desc_zh: 右下两人，一立一坐，望向层层绿谷与远山。谷中有小聚落，土路蜿蜒。云很厚，绿很满，人只是尺码。
desc_en: Lower right, two figures—one standing, one seated—face layered green valleys and far ridges. A small settlement, winding tracks. Heavy cloud, full green; people only for scale.

desc_zh: 草脊上立着一棵鲜绿针叶树，旁有人坐在石上，铁丝围栏斜过。土路向右下蜿蜒，远峰入云。树成了画面里最稳的锚点。
desc_en: A bright conifer stands on a grassy spur; someone sits nearby on rock, a wire fence running past. A dirt path winds down right; peaks enter cloud. The tree anchors the whole frame.

title_en: Looking Out from the Bloom Slope
desc_zh: 下半幅花草坡，一人背坐石上。层层绿丘与远山蓝调推开，头顶积云鼓胀。蓝天从云缝露出，旅途里最常见的那种停一下。
desc_en: Lower half a flowered slope; someone sits on rock, back to camera. Green ridges stack into blue distant hills under swelling cumulus. Blue peeks through—the ordinary pause every journey knows.

desc_zh: 花甸更密，黄紫交杂，背影坐在灰石上。远山层层退蓝，厚云低压。与上一张同处，换一个更贴近花草的焦距。
desc_en: A denser meadow of yellow and purple; a back view on grey rock. Ridges fade blue under low heavy cloud. Same place as the last—only the flowers pulled closer.

desc_zh: 高处草甸，几匹马与人散落：左下有人坐在棕马与白马旁，右侧有人牵马。脊上细土路伸向谷，远峰挂云。停顿，而不是赶路。
