desc_en: On a high meadow, horses and people scatter: someone sits by a brown and a white horse; another stands with mounts to the right. Thin tracks lead to the valley; peaks hold cloud. A rest, not a rush.

desc_zh: 湖面如镜，倒映秋色与雾中山脊。右岸陡壁旁停着一辆绿白巴士，中景有几辆白车。初雪贴着峰线，旅途的痕迹很小，山色很大。
desc_en: Glass-calm water mirrors autumn trees and misted ridges. A green-and-white coach sits by the cliff road; a few white cars further in. First snow along the peaks—travel traces small, the mountain large.

desc_zh: 岸边一棵圆冠红树，旁是金黄细高的秋树，倒影完整落入青灰水面。后山深绿针叶与灰岩壁。栈道上有零星游人，色块比人更抢眼。
desc_en: A round crimson crown beside tall golden autumn trees, their reflection whole on grey-turquoise water. Dark conifers and grey cliff behind. A few walkers on the boardwalk—color louder than people.

desc_zh: 竖幅里湖面把两岸山形对折成近乎菱形的倒影。岸线秋黄与深绿交错，峰顶被白雾吞掉。没有建筑，只有静与冷。
desc_en: Vertical: the lake folds both shores into a near-diamond reflection. Autumn gold and deep green along the bank; peaks swallowed by white mist. No buildings—only stillness and cold.

desc_zh: 深谷夹一湾静水，左岸林间有薄雪。厚雾压住峰顶，秋色被压成低饱和的橙黄。倒影近乎完整，像把山谷再抄写一遍。
desc_en: A still bend of water between steep forested walls; thin snow in the left trees. Thick mist sits on the summits; autumn muted to soft ochre. The reflection nearly complete—a second copy of the valley.

desc_zh: 左岸金黄与绯红秋树连成一条暖带，倒影清晰。后山深绿，峰脊落薄雪，低云贴谷。秋与冬在同一条水线上握手。
desc_en: A warm band of gold and crimson along the left shore, reflection sharp. Dark evergreen slopes; thin snow on the ridges under low cloud. Autumn and winter meet on one waterline.

desc_zh: 左岸金黄落叶松中夹一棵深红，右侧有矮岛灌丛。峰顶雾雪交叠，湖面几乎无纹。一点红，整幅冷调才有了温度。
desc_en: Among golden larches on the left, one deep red crown; a low brushy islet to the right. Mist and snow on the peaks; water nearly glass. One red note warms the whole cool frame.

desc_zh: 前景宽幅跌水跨过苔石，中段一柱岩顶黄绿灌丛。后景湖湾与针叶林，再往后是雾中雪峰。水声被画面压成静的白。
desc_en: A wide tiered fall crosses mossy rock; a central pillar holds yellow-green scrub. Beyond: a lake bay, conifers, then snow peaks in mist. Sound of water becomes quiet white in the frame.

desc_zh: 近处水面细细起皱，岸边秋黄矮灌接深绿针叶。两侧山坡落霜雪，正中远峰从雾缝露出三角尖。冷色铺满，只有林缘一点暖。
desc_en: Fine ripples fill the near water; autumn scrub meets dark conifers along the bank. Frosted slopes on both sides; a triangular peak shows through mist. Cool tones everywhere—warmth only at the tree line.

desc_zh: 近处石堰式跌水并排落下，水花白。其后是覆雪针叶林斜坡，再上是厚云吞住的雪峰。色调近乎黑白，冷得干净。
desc_en: A stone weir of parallel falls in front, white water. Behind, a snow-laden conifer slope; above, a snow peak eaten by thick cloud. Nearly monochrome—cold and clean.

desc_zh: 陡坡针叶挂满新雪，几株金黄秋树插在其间。岸线有彩色小点游人，左下薄冰伸入水面。倒影微颤，冷暖并置。
desc_en: Steep conifers heavy with new snow; a few golden autumn trees among them. Tiny colorful figures on the shore; a jagged ice shelf lower left. Rippled reflection—cold and warm side by side.

desc_zh: 画面大半是覆雪针叶林的重复纹理，左下几株金黄落叶松破开冷调。远峰入雾。近看是树，远看是一片静。
desc_en: Most of the frame is repeating snow-laden conifers; lower left, golden larches break the cool field. Far peaks enter mist. Up close: trees. From afar: stillness.

desc_zh: 下半幅灰蓝静水，岸上一排金黄落叶松挂薄雪。后山斜坡覆雪入云，岸边有彩色衣点。秋色被雪压住，却更亮。
desc_en: Grey-blue still water fills the lower half; a row of golden larches on the snowy shore, needles dusted white. Snow slope rises into cloud; tiny bright jackets along the bank. Autumn under snow—brighter, not quieter.

title_en: Fire and Ice Along the Shore
desc_zh: 横幅湖面铺灰，岸线秋橙与新雪贴在一起。右坡针叶全白，左丘缓开。游人缩成细线，季节交界写在同一条岸上。
desc_en: Wide grey lake; autumn orange and fresh snow share the shoreline. Right slope all white conifers; left hills open softer. Walkers shrink to a thin line—two seasons on one bank.

desc_zh: 近岸浅水透出卵石与覆雪大石，湖面倒映雪压针叶。左岸几点金黄秋树。人在远处岸线走动，像给静面点上标尺。
desc_en: Near shallows show pebbles and snow-capped boulders; the lake mirrors snow-heavy conifers. A few golden trees on the left bank. Distant walkers along the shore—a scale mark on stillness.

desc_zh: 大片新雪占下半幅，左一棵细高金橙树立住画面。中景湖湾与游人，两侧山坡覆雪入雾。脚印浅浅，像刚走过。
desc_en: Fresh snow fills the lower third; one slender gold-orange tree holds the left. A lake bay and walkers mid-frame; snow slopes enter mist. Shallow footprints—as if just passed through.

desc_zh: 下半幅雪压针叶，底部一株金黄特别醒目。中段云带横过，尖峰穿出淡蓝天。竖构图把「仰头」这件事做得干净。
desc_en: Snow-laden conifers below; one golden tree bright at the bottom. A cloud band mid-frame; a jagged peak pierces pale blue. Vertical—looking up, done cleanly.

desc_zh: 近处雪林夹金黄落叶松，中段雪坡被软雾切断，尖峰露出。底缘栈道上人影极小。冷白与金黄并置，季节还没真正分开。
desc_en: Snow forest with golden larches in front; soft mist cuts the mid slope; a sharp peak shows above. Tiny figures on a boardwalk at the edge. Cold white and gold—seasons not yet fully apart.

desc_zh: 下半幅银白霜林，右下几株金黄点破冷调。中峰灰岩挂雪，云带绕腰。蓝天干净，像把冬天的骨架露出来。
desc_en: Silvery frosted forest below; golden trees lower right break the cool. A grey rocky peak holds snow, cloud around its waist. Clear blue—winter’s structure laid bare.

desc_zh: 三角雪峰居中，云雾绕脚。下半幅雪压针叶与金黄树，底缘有细小人影。天更蓝，山更清楚，冷意也更利。
desc_en: A triangular snow peak centered, mist at its feet. Snow-laden conifers and golden trees below; tiny figures at the edge. Bluer sky, clearer mountain—cold made sharper.

desc_zh: 前景新雪与枯草，中景静湖与金黄针叶林。岸左一枚大红心形装置，游人彩色衣点散落。远山入雾，一点红把冷场轻轻点醒。
desc_en: Fresh snow and dry grass in front; still lake and golden conifers mid-frame. A large red heart sculpture on the left shore; colorful walkers scattered. Far peaks in mist—one red note waking the cold.

desc_zh: 雪原接暗色湖面，岸边几根枯干竖起，右岸金黄落叶松成片。左山厚雪入云，人在岸线缩小。秋色像还没走完的台词。
desc_en: Snowfield meets dark water; bare trunks rise near shore; golden larches mass on the right. Left mountain heavy with snow into cloud; people shrink along the bank. Autumn like a line not yet finished.

title_en: Golden Trees at the Ice Edge
desc_zh: 近处冰面与覆雪石块、枯草。对岸金黄与深绿交错，挂雪清楚。左山岩壁覆雪，蓝天留白。冷场里，金树像唯一的暖源。
desc_en: Ice, snow-capped rocks and dry grass in front. Across: gold and deep green mixed, snow clear on branches. Left cliff dusted white under blue sky. In the cold field, golden trees are the only warmth.

desc_zh: 前景厚雪脚印，中景薄冰被侧光打成金闪，右有一隅清水与雪石。对岸霜林与灰白山壁。红心倒影极小，像误入的标点。
desc_en: Thick snow and footprints in front; thin ice mid-frame catches side light as gold glitter; clear water and a snow rock to the right. Frosted forest and grey cliff beyond. A tiny red heart reflection—like a stray punctuation mark.

desc_zh: 近处几株金橙针叶挂薄雪，占住画面重心。右后陡坡覆雪岩壁，峰顶有雾。蓝天浅淡，秋冬交界被压缩进几棵树里。
desc_en: Golden-orange conifers dusted with thin snow hold the frame. Behind right, a steep snow-rock slope; mist on the peaks. Pale blue sky—autumn meeting winter, compressed into a few trees.

desc_zh: 下三分之一是挂雪的金黄与深绿针叶，上端一座金字塔尖峰居中，岩脊与白雪分明。厚云贴着侧峰。暖林托住冷峰，季节交界写得很满。
desc_en: Lower third: snow-dusted gold and deep-green conifers. Above, a pyramidal peak centered—dark rock ridges and bright snow. Thick cloud on the side summits. Warm forest under cold peak—the seasonal seam filled in.

desc_zh: 近处金黄落叶松挂薄雪，后接更白的针叶带。上方三角岩峰陡立，灰黑岩面与挂雪对比强烈，天色灰白。抬头一眼，秋被山压得很低。
desc_en: Golden larches with thin snow in front, then whiter frosted conifers. A steep triangular peak above—charcoal rock against clinging snow under pale grey sky. Looking up: autumn held low under the mountain.

desc_zh: 浅灰混凝土小径直伸进林深处，两侧细高树干成列。左冠亮绿，右偏针叶深绿。远处三个背影很小，光从叶隙漏下。
desc_en: A pale grey concrete path runs into the forest; slender trunks line both sides. Bright deciduous green left, darker conifers right. Three tiny figures ahead; light filters through the canopy.

desc_zh: 浓绿枝叶拱成隧道，土路上两人戴草帽并肩走远。掌状亮叶绿在逆光里。林深处透出一点空地白，像出口还远。
desc_en: Dense foliage arches into a tunnel; two straw-hatted figures walk the dirt path ahead. Fan-shaped leaves glow backlit. A pale clearing shows far through the trees—exit still distant.

desc_zh: 近处碎石土路弯进灌丛，右侧圆锥形针叶树立着。后山全绿，峰脊被白雾罩住。阴天软光，绿意被压得很满。
desc_en: A stony dirt path curves into scrub; a conical fir stands right. The ridge beyond is all green, crest under white mist. Soft overcast light—green held full and quiet.

desc_zh: 低处蕨与阔叶铺满，几株细高针叶与亮绿阔叶树交错。左上留出灰白天空一小块。像站在林缘抬头的那一眼。
desc_en: Ferns and broad leaves carpet below; slender conifers mix with bright lime deciduous crowns. A small patch of pale sky upper left—looking up from the forest edge.

title_en: Whisper in a Shaft of Light
desc_zh: 土径上，一束天光落在大人与孩童之间；大人俯身轻触孩子头顶，手杖与白袋在侧。四周深绿压暗，暖意只在这一小块亮处。
desc_en: On a dirt trail, a shaft of light falls on an adult and a child—hand gently on the child’s head, pole and white bag aside. Deep green shadow around; warmth only in that small bright patch.

desc_zh: 几根直干立在深绿地被上，树基有苔。中景一株叶色更亮的阔叶树探出。后景针叶密实。没有人，只有树的间距。
desc_en: Straight trunks rise from a deep-green floor, moss at the bases. A brighter deciduous tree shows mid-frame; dense conifers behind. No people—only the spacing of trees.

desc_zh: 碎石土路从近处弯向右侧消失，两侧蕨与针叶夹道。中段亮绿阔叶透光，深处更暗。无人，只有脚步会留下的那种静。
desc_en: A gravel path bends right and vanishes; ferns and conifers flank it. Mid-frame lime leaves catch light; deeper woods go dark. Empty—the quiet footsteps leave behind.

desc_zh: 土径右下，蓝外套背包旅人侧头仰望。红褐树干挂绿苔，林冠亮绿。水壶与挂饰在包侧轻轻晃着，像刚停下一步。
desc_en: Lower right on a dirt path, a traveler in a blue jacket and backpack looks up. Red-brown trunks hold green moss; the canopy bright. Bottle and charms on the pack—paused mid-step.

desc_zh: 蓝外套黑短裤旅人背对镜头沿石土路走。包上橙锁扣与白色小挂件。左下苔石，细干成列，光从叶隙洒下。
desc_en: Blue jacket, black shorts—walking away along a stony dirt path. Orange carabiners and a small white charm on the pack. Mossy rock lower left; slender trunks; light through leaves.

title_en: Looking Up as the Trail Climbs
desc_zh: 右下深色外套旅人持杖上行，细高针叶直冲画幅上沿。苔与蕨铺满两侧。人小树高，进山这件事被竖幅说得很直白。
desc_en: Lower right, a dark-jacketed hiker with a pole climbs; slender conifers shoot past the top edge. Moss and ferns on both sides. Small person, tall trees—the climb said plainly in vertical.

desc_zh: 左下旅人微微前倾，杖点在石土坡上。红褐树干、苔与蕨挤满画面。光柔，绿饱和，脚步沉稳而不急。
desc_en: Lower left, a hiker leans into the climb, pole on the stony slope. Red-brown trunks, moss and ferns fill the frame. Soft light, saturated green—steady steps, no rush.

desc_zh: 近谷深绿，几点白墙小屋嵌在林间。远山层层退成青蓝，厚云压顶。一条细公路在谷底隐约可见。远望，比进林更静。
desc_en: Deep green valley below; a few white-walled roofs among trees. Ridges fade blue under thick cloud. A thin road faintly in the hollow. Looking out—quieter even than walking in.

desc_zh: 细干成排，林底蕨与阔叶铺满，几点小黄花。前景略虚，深处透出雾白。没有路牌，只有往里走的暗示。
desc_en: Slender trunks in a row; ferns and broad leaves carpet the floor with tiny yellow blooms. Soft front blur; misty pale light deeper in. No signposts—only the hint of walking further.

desc_zh: 洋红叶子花垂入画面，女子仰头笑，手抬到颊边。米白裹胸与紫纹筒裙，银耳饰。后景织物摊位虚成色块，光斑落在肩上。
desc_en: Magenta bougainvillea drops into the frame; she laughs upward, hand near her cheek. Cream bandeau, purple patterned wrap, silver earrings. Market textiles blur behind; light spots her shoulder.

desc_zh: 同样花廊下，侧脸低目安静。叶影落在肩与面。后景挂满彩色布料，与前头的素色衣形成对比。热闹在外，静在脸上。
desc_en: Same flower canopy; a quiet profile, eyes down. Leaf shadows on face and shoulder. Bright textiles hang behind—busy color against a plain outfit. Noise outside; stillness on the face.

desc_zh: 斜光切过，女子伏在旧木案上，颊贴手臂。背后蓝白几何织物垂落。明暗很硬，却把安静写得很柔。
desc_en: A slant of light; she leans on weathered wood, cheek on her arm. Blue-and-white geometric cloth hangs behind. Hard contrast—yet the quiet stays soft.

title_en: Looking Out from the Timber Gallery
desc_zh: 深色木梁框住半身，女子倚栏望右。米白露腰装，银耳饰。身后浓绿树冠压暗，侧光暖在肩臂。木与绿把人托得很稳。
desc_en: Dark timber beams frame her; she rests on the rail looking right. Cream midriff set, silver earrings. Dense green canopy behind; warm side light on shoulder and arm. Wood and green hold her steady.

desc_zh: 竹摇椅上闭目倚坐，白裹胸与蓝白纹筒裙。竹帘筛下的光斑落在砖地与手臂。热天里难得的彻底停顿。
desc_en: Eyes closed in a bamboo rocker; white bandeau, blue-and-white wrap. Bamboo screen casts dappled light on brick and arms. A complete pause in the heat.

desc_zh: 侧影倚在深色木柱，手背在身后，低目。米白与深紫筒裙，右外热带绿叶透亮。明暗分界清楚，人像停在光与荫之间。
desc_en: Profile against a dark timber pillar, hands behind, eyes down. Cream and deep-purple wrap; tropical green bright to the right. Clear light-dark edge—paused between sun and shade.

desc_zh: 室内深影，一束暖光落在盘坐女子的面与肩。纱帘与木椽在侧，外有绿意。低目静坐，像把一天的热气关在门外。
desc_en: Deep interior shade; one warm beam on a seated woman’s face and shoulders. Sheer curtain and rafters aside; green beyond. Eyes down—keeping the day’s heat outside.

desc_zh: 坐在木台边望向窗外强光，发髻小花，银耳饰。左有红粉织布，右有纱网。轮廓被光勾出，室内其余退暗。
desc_en: Seated by a wooden ledge facing strong outdoor light; a small flower in the bun, silver earrings. Red-pink textile left, mesh right. Rim light draws the outline; the room falls away.

desc_zh: 俯侧，暖光只照面颊与肩背，余部入暗。背景几何织毯红白紫隐现。耳环垂金属穗，安静得几乎听得见呼吸。
desc_en: High angle, side light only on cheek and shoulder; the rest into dark. Geometric textile in red, white, purple behind. Metal fringe earrings—quiet enough to hear a breath.

desc_zh: 木栏旁，侧光切亮半边脸与肩，其余沉入阴影。白裹胸，发髻干净。砖墙与暗帘只剩轮廓。光像从门缝漏进来的一句。
desc_en: By a wooden rail, side light cuts half a face and shoulder; the rest sinks. White bandeau, neat bun. Brick and dark curtain only as outlines. Light like a sentence through a doorway.

desc_zh: 臂倚浅色木栏，仰侧望光。太阳纹银耳饰清晰。背景砖与帘几乎全黑。与上一张同处，光更满一点，神情仍克制。
desc_en: Arm on a light wooden rail, looking up into the light. Sun-motif silver earring sharp. Brick and curtain nearly black. Same place as the last—fuller light, still restrained.

desc_zh: 胸以上特写，背景近黑。暖光勾额鼻颊与前臂，手放松搁在木栏。米白裹胸，垂饰耳环。把旅途收成一张脸。
desc_en: Chest-up against near-black. Warm light on brow, nose, cheek and forearm; hand easy on the rail. Cream bandeau, dangling earring. The journey reduced to one face.

desc_zh: 木廊矮凳上坐着，双手托一小圆竹篮。淡紫裹胸与深紫纹裙。砖墙木柱，侧光柔。像午后还没决定要不要起身。
desc_en: On a low stool on a timber porch, holding a small round bamboo basket. Pale lavender bandeau, deep purple patterned skirt. Brick and posts; soft side light. Afternoon—not yet deciding to stand.

desc_zh: 赤足女子高举绿管喷出细雾，逆光闪亮。身后陡斜木瓦屋顶与红砖墙，旁有小树。米白与靛青纹裙，花园里一记轻快的日常。
desc_en: Barefoot, she lifts a green hose into a fine mist, backlit. Behind: a steep wooden-shingle roof and red brick, a small tree aside. Cream and indigo patterned wrap—a light domestic beat in the garden.

desc_zh: 背影立在草地上，墨绿筒裙与白上衣贴住肩线。绿管扬起一道细雾，逆光里水珠发亮，身后是层层叠叠的旧瓦。热带午后，只留这一瞬清凉。
desc_en: From behind, a dark patterned sarong and white wrap catch the shoulder line. A green hose lifts a fine spray that glows against stacked clay tiles. One cool instant in a tropical afternoon.

desc_zh: 侧脸望向左方，水雾在暗瓦前散成银弧。砖墙与小树守在一边，天空浅灰。裙摆的白纹与水光轻轻呼应，像旅途里随手记下的一页。
desc_en: In profile, a misty arc brightens against dark tiles. Brick and a small tree hold one side; the sky stays pale. White patterns on the skirt echo the spray—a quiet page from the road.

desc_zh: 暗木门框收紧画面，一束暖光落在侧脸与肩。砖墙斑驳，金饰佛像半隐在阴影里。耳饰微微晃，表情安静，像走进寺廊时忽然停住的呼吸。
desc_en: Dark carved frames tighten the shot; warm light finds a profile and shoulder. Weathered brick, a gilded figure half in shadow. Quiet earrings, a held breath in a temple corridor.

desc_zh: 大片热带叶压住上半幅，暖光只照亮面颊与胸口。米白抹胸与深色筒裙沉在暗绿里。黄昏将尽，园子把声音都收了起来。
desc_en: Broad tropical leaves fill the upper frame; warm light touches only face and chest. Cream and dark indigo sink into green dusk. The garden holds its sound.

desc_zh: 低机位仰看，粗糙树干与气根缠绕身后。米白衣料贴着暖光，银花耳饰垂下。一小角蓝天从叶隙漏出，像被树荫借走的片刻。
desc_en: From low, gnarled bark and aerial roots rise behind. Cream fabric takes golden light; a floral earring hangs still. A scrap of blue sky slips through the canopy.

title_en: Looking Back on the Brick Path
desc_zh: 高机位俯看背影，手扶深色木栏。陶灯立在一侧，窄砖路伸进树影。靛青裙摆的白纹清晰，热带庭院在暮色里慢慢暗下去。
desc_en: From above, a back turns toward a wooden rail. A terracotta lantern stands aside; a brick path slips into shade. White patterns on indigo catch the last garden light.

desc_zh: 木凳靠着青绿砖墙，白衣垂落，目光向下。窗台上花盆与杯盏安静排列，脚边砾石细碎。像在一处慢店门口，把午后坐成一种习惯。
desc_en: A wooden bench against teal brick; white layers fall, gaze lowered. Pots and cups rest on the sill, gravel underfoot. An unhurried afternoon outside a slow shop.

desc_zh: 竹竿拼成的桌前坐下，草帽与竹框镜挂满白砖。黄菊插在玻璃瓶里，手边是宽檐帽。墙上「普洱」二字隐约可见，光很干净。
desc_en: At a bamboo-pole table, straw hats and a sunburst mirror cover white tile. Yellow chrysanthemums in glass; a wide hat nearby. The characters for Pu'er sit quietly on the wall.

desc_zh: 双肘支在竹桌上，掌心托住脸颊，笑意浅浅。白裙与蓝花凉鞋落在石板地上，砖块垫高桌脚。草帽、黄菊与垂挂绿植，把小店角布置得很松。
desc_en: Elbows on bamboo, palms soft at the cheeks, a light smile. White dress and blue floral sandals on stone; bricks level the table. Hats, chrysanthemums, and hanging greens keep the corner loose.

desc_zh: 高机位只见后脑与白衫，圆形竹辐镜里映出抬手理发的侧影。草帽环绕镜框，「普洱」二字压在下方。像把路过写成一次对视。
desc_en: From above, only nape and white shirt; a bamboo-spoke mirror holds a profile adjusting hair. Straw hats ring the glass; Pu'er lettering sits below. A passing glance kept still.

desc_zh: 半透明白衫绣着细花，肩线回望镜头。背后草帽层层叠叠，日轮镜嵌在正中。光线柔亮，耳际碎发轻轻晃。
desc_en: Sheer embroidered cream, a look over the shoulder. Layered straw hats fill the wall; a sunburst mirror sits center. Soft light, a few loose strands.

desc_zh: 前景虚掉肩背，焦点落在日轮镜里的笑脸与抬手。浅蓝无袖衣映在草帽围成的白墙上，「普洱」二字清晰。旅途里的玩笑，被圆镜收住。
desc_en: A blurred shoulder frames a sunburst mirror: smile, hand near chin, pale blue sleeveless top. Hats crowd the white wall; Pu'er characters stay clear. A travel joke caught in the round.

desc_zh: 粉紫花枝压住画面上缘，白衣站在灰石地上。红绸带垂着金铃，落瓣散在脚边。高机位穿过花丛，把庭院收成一帧安静。
desc_en: Pink-purple bougainvillea crowds the top; white layers stand on grey stone. Red ribbons end in gold bells; petals scatter underfoot. From above, the courtyard settles into one quiet frame.

desc_zh: 俯视中，洋红三角梅层层围住。薄纱白衫绣花清晰，银项链细细一条。石面落瓣，红带金铃轻垂，像走进被花荫借来的午后。
desc_en: From above, magenta bougainvillea rings the figure. Sheer embroidered white, a thin silver chain. Petals on stone, red ribbons with bells—an afternoon borrowed under bloom.

desc_zh: 浅蓝无袖裙在石板上抬手，粉花枝虚在前景。落瓣、红带与圆坛绿意围成一圈。笑意侧开，像刚被叫住的一瞬。
desc_en: A sleeveless sky-blue dress on stone, hand near the face; pink blooms soft in front. Petals, red ribbons, a round planter of green. A smile caught mid-turn.

desc_zh: 蓝裙在灰石上微微旋开，目光向下。三角梅与红绸金铃压住上半幅，落瓣铺路。旁人裤脚虚在边角，主体仍是这一步安静。
desc_en: Sky blue flares slightly on grey stone, eyes down. Bougainvillea and red ribbons with bells fill the top; petals pave the way. A blurred jean leg at the edge; the quiet step stays center.

desc_zh: 双手抬至额前，花影落在蓝裙与面颊。石板落瓣，红带金铃垂在枝间。阳光穿过三角梅，把午后写得很亮。
desc_en: Hands at the brow; flower shadows cross blue fabric and skin. Petals on stone, red ribbons among branches. Sun through bougainvillea writes the afternoon bright.

desc_zh: 仰头对镜，双手仍在额际，浅蓝裙领口微皱。粉花虚实交叠，金铃红带晃在枝上。石面落瓣，像被叫到名字时的那一秒。
desc_en: Looking up, hands still at the brow, sky-blue neckline soft. Pink blooms layer near and far; bells on red ribbons. Petals on stone—the second of being called.

desc_zh: 俯视里，花枝阴影切过脸与衣料。浅蓝裙、白表、金镯同在一帧。红带金铃与落瓣提醒：这是热带院子里的正午。
desc_en: From above, branch shadows cut across face and fabric. Sky blue, a white watch, a gold bracelet in one frame. Red ribbons, bells, and petals mark a tropical noon.

desc_zh: 白纱绣衣，银链贴颈，目光低垂闭拢。粉花近在前景，红绸金铃垂下。光斑在面颊游走，石板与苔坛安静托住这一刻。
desc_en: Ivory lace over white, a silver chain; eyes lowered, almost closed. Pink blooms close in; red ribbons with bells hang. Light freckles the cheek; stone and moss hold the quiet.

desc_zh: 白纱外衫绣花与流苏清楚，仰望镜头。洋红三角梅从上下压来，红带一线。落瓣与苔坛在侧，神情克制而亮。
desc_en: Sheer embroidered cream with fringe, face tilted to the lens. Magenta bougainvillea presses from above and below; one red ribbon. Petals and moss aside—bright, restrained.

desc_zh: 背影立在砖径上，白纱绣衣与流苏垂落。手扶深绿木栏，紫牵牛点在密叶里。棕袋斜挎，像在巷口忽然被花墙留住。
desc_en: From behind on brick, cream embroidery and fringe fall. A hand rests on dark green fencing; purple morning glories punctuate dense vines. A brown tote—stopped by a flowered wall.

desc_zh: 人字砖道上，浅蓝套装垂至脚踝。青绿字「Julie」写在红砖弧墙上，龟背竹叶垂下。手抬额际，桃粉小包贴身，光很柔。
desc_en: On herringbone brick, a sky-blue set falls to the ankles. Teal letters spelling Julie on a curved red wall; monstera leaves hang. Hand at the brow, a peach mini bag—soft light.

desc_zh: 同一弧墙，浅蓝裙与白凉鞋站定。低头整理额发，桃粉包斜挎。龟背竹与「Julie」字样仍在，街沿干净，像刚走出店门。
desc_en: Same curved brick, sky blue and white sandals. Head down, adjusting hair; peach bag across the body. Monstera and Julie lettering remain—clean curb, just outside a door.

desc_zh: 灰墙上黄字「28」醒目，仙人掌与龙血树挤在一侧。浅蓝套装双手背后，浅笑对镜。热带植物与社区墙面撞在一起，却意外安静。
desc_en: Yellow 28 on grey concrete; cactus and spiky greens crowd one side. Sky-blue set, hands behind, a soft smile. Tropical plants meet a neighborhood wall—oddly quiet.

desc_zh: 侧卧在几何纹毯上，白纱绣衣与流苏铺开。木窗台下，彩色靠垫叠着。闭目或低眼，院子里的午后被放得很慢。
desc_en: Sideways on a geometric throw, white sheer and fringe spread. Colorful cushions under a wood window ledge. Eyes closed or down—an afternoon slowed in the courtyard.

desc_zh: 俯身趴在日床上，白纱裙裾与蕾丝边清楚。藤编小盘在手边，窗外绿意虚影。笑意浅浅，像刚被阳光叫醒。
desc_en: Lying prone on the daybed, white sheer and lace clear. A woven tray nearby; green soft beyond the window. A light smile, as if just woken by sun.

desc_zh: 高一点的视角，白衣侧卧，头枕手背。彩色纹毯与靠垫、圆木凳同在一角。窗外绿植与人影隐约，光亮而干净。
desc_en: Slightly higher view: white layers on the side, head on the hand. Patterned throw, cushions, a round stool. Greenery and a faint figure beyond the window—bright, clean.

desc_zh: 白纱长袍绣花与流苏铺满日床，一手抬向额前。粉蓝几何靠垫托住肩背，藤盘在侧。闭目侧脸，像把阳光当成一种休息。
desc_en: White embroidered robe and fringe fill the daybed; one arm rises to the brow. Pink and blue geometric cushions; a rattan tray aside. Eyes closed—sun as rest.

desc_zh: 藕粉碎花露肩上衣，黑裤与棕袋。闭目侧脸，阔叶热带植物贴在身后。石径延伸，黄墙屋檐在远景虚开，像走进一处被绿意围住的院子。
desc_en: Dusty-rose floral off-shoulder top, black trousers, brown tote. Profile, eyes closed; broad tropical leaves close behind. Stone path ahead, a yellow eave soft in the distance.

desc_zh: 半身取景，粉花露肩袖鼓起，目光向左上方。棕纹托特斜挎，绿叶挤满背景。石径一线伸向右侧，光软而匀。
desc_en: Half-length: pink floral off-shoulder sleeves full, gaze up and left. Patterned brown tote; green leaves crowd the back. A path slips right—soft, even light.

desc_zh: 粉紫碎花露肩裙，手握三角梅贴近脸侧。红砖墙虚在身后，花色饱和。浅笑望向花枝，像被颜色轻轻绊住。
desc_en: Pink-lilac floral off-shoulder dress; a hand brings bougainvillea near the face. Red brick soft behind, color saturated. A light smile toward the branch.

desc_zh: 头向后仰，口微张，像要碰那一簇洋红。手仍执花枝，砖墙与奶油墙分列两侧。玩笑写在脸上，旅途忽然变轻。
desc_en: Head thrown back, mouth open toward magenta clusters. Still holding a stem; brick and cream walls on either side. A joke on the face—the journey turns light.

desc_zh: 闭眼大笑，手拉花枝近脸。洋红三角梅压住上半幅，红砖纹理清楚。粉花露肩裙与银链安静，快乐却很响。
desc_en: Eyes shut in a full laugh, pulling blooms close. Magenta fills the top; red brick texture clear. Soft floral dress and silver chain—joy loud, styling quiet.

desc_zh: 大笑侧仰，手持花枝。黄墙与红砖分列，三角梅从顶倾泻。袖口鼓起，红绳手串一闪，像路边忽然停住的欢喜。
desc_en: Open laugh, tilted back, stem in hand. Yellow plaster and red brick; bougainvillea spills from above. Full sleeves, a red-string bracelet—joy that stops you on the street.

desc_zh: 头微侧，笑得眯眼。洋红花枝在左，砖墙在右。粉紫露肩裙领口系带清楚，光柔，像被花香逗住。
desc_en: Head tipped, eyes squinted in a smile. Magenta left, brick right. Lace-up dusty-rose neckline clear; soft light, as if caught by scent.

desc_zh: 正面大笑，露齿，手执紫花近颊。头顶三角梅浓密，砖缝清晰。旅途里最不需要解释的一种表情。
desc_en: Facing forward, open-mouthed smile, purple blooms by the cheek. Dense bougainvillea above; mortar lines sharp. A travel face that needs no caption.

desc_zh: 洋红花丛拱在头顶，露肩碎花裙正对镜头。笑意完整，手轻触枝条。红砖与奶油墙把颜色托得很稳。
desc_en: Magenta arches overhead; off-shoulder floral dress faces the lens. Full smile, fingers light on a stem. Brick and cream hold the color steady.

desc_zh: 坐在风化石沿上，双手捂胸，口型惊喜。粉花露肩衫配黑阔腿裤，蓝花凉鞋。棕纹包搁在一侧，黄白小花挤满绿篱。
desc_en: On a weathered ledge, hands at the chest, mouth open in delight. Pink floral off-shoulder, black wide legs, blue floral sandals. Patterned tote aside; yellow-white blooms crowd the hedge.

desc_zh: 半身坐姿，一手近领口，笑意对着镜头。粉花上衣与黑裤，棕包黑带垂下。石沿生苔，绿篱高过头顶，像被花园轻轻围住。
desc_en: Seated half-length, one hand near the neckline, smile to camera. Pink floral top, black trousers; brown tote with black strap. Mossy ledge, hedge above the head—held by the garden.

desc_zh: 坐在石沿，右手轻覆胸口，浅笑。粉紫露肩碎花衫，黑阔腿裤。绿篱开着黄红小花，包在身侧。神情克制，像刚说完一句谢谢。
desc_en: On the ledge, right hand soft at the chest, a gentle smile. Dusty pink-lilac off-shoulder, black wide legs. Yellow and red flecks in the hedge; tote beside. Restrained—like a quiet thank-you.

desc_zh: 全身坐姿，笑意更开，手仍在胸口。粉花鼓袖清楚，黑裤与石沿生苔。黄白红花点缀密叶，像一幅被风吹软的肖像。
desc_en: Full seated pose, smile wider, hand still at the chest. Full floral sleeves; black trousers on a mossy ledge. Yellow, white, red flecks in dense green—a portrait softened by breeze.

desc_zh: 闭眼仰笑，手贴胸口。粉花露肩衫与黑阔腿裤，浅蓝凉鞋。绿篱与洋红三角梅在侧，石沿粗粝，快乐写得很满。
desc_en: Eyes closed, head back in a laugh, hand on the chest. Floral off-shoulder, black wide legs, pale blue sandals. Hedge and magenta blooms aside; rough ledge—joy written full.

desc_zh: 侧坐石沿，一手抬额，大笑向左。粉纱鼓袖与系带飘落，黑裤收住下半。绿篱白星小花细碎，像被阳光忽然叫住。
desc_en: Sideways on the ledge, hand at the brow, laughing left. Sheer pink sleeves and ties fall; black trousers hold the lower half. Tiny white stars in the hedge—caught by sudden sun.

desc_zh: 侧坐，闭目微微笑，手臂松松搁着。粉花露肩与黑裤，绿篱黄红点点。石沿浅褐，像把风和花香都记进皮肤。
desc_en: Seated sideways, eyes closed, soft smile; arms loose. Floral off-shoulder and black trousers; yellow-red flecks in green. Pale brown ledge—wind and scent held in the skin.

desc_zh: 正对镜头浅笑，粉紫露肩鼓袖清楚。银链细细，绿篱开着黄粉红花。石沿托住半身，像园子里被叫住的一帧。
desc_en: Facing the lens with a soft smile; dusty pink-lilac sleeves full. Thin silver chain; yellow, pink, red in the hedge. The ledge holds half the body—a frame called in the garden.

desc_zh: 半身近景，头微侧，浅笑。粉花露肩领口与银链清楚，绿篱虚成柔焦。光柔，像把旅途缩成一张脸。
desc_en: Close half-length, head tipped, soft smile. Floral neckline and silver chain clear; hedge soft behind. Gentle light—the journey reduced to a face.

desc_zh: 低机位仰看，粉花鼓袖靠着气根缠绕的树干。闭目或微睁向上，银链贴颈。叶隙漏光，把热带树荫写得很厚。
desc_en: From low, pink floral sleeves against a trunk wrapped in aerial roots. Eyes closed or half open upward; silver at the neck. Light through leaves—tropical shade made thick.

desc_zh: 侧脸闭目，阳光穿过叶隙落在颊与肩。藕粉碎花鼓袖，银链微亮。暗绿阔叶托住背景，像把热气也滤成安静。
desc_en: Profile, eyes closed; sun through leaves freckles cheek and shoulder. Dusty-pink floral sleeves; silver faintly bright. Dark broad leaves hold the back—heat filtered into quiet.

desc_zh: 全身站在石径，粉花鼓袖与黑裤，棕包提在手。阔叶与棕榈虚在身后，暖光贴面。像傍晚回房前，顺手留下的一张。
desc_en: Full figure on stone path: pink floral sleeves, black trousers, brown tote in hand. Broad leaves and palms soft behind; warm light on the face. One frame before evening returns indoors.

desc_zh: 砖径落叶，粉花露肩上衣与黑裤。浅笑对镜，包与手机同握。阔叶热带植物贴身，金色时分把绿色染暖。
desc_en: Fallen leaves on brick; pink floral off-shoulder and black trousers. Soft smile; tote and phone in one hand. Broad tropical leaves close; golden hour warms the green.

desc_zh: 走向镜头又侧目，粉花鼓袖与黑阔腿裤。棕包与折纸同握，棕榈夹道。晚光贴肩，像行程将尽时仍不肯收起的一步。
desc_en: Walking toward the lens, gaze aside; floral sleeves and black wide legs. Tote and folded paper in hand; palms line the path. Late light on the shoulder—one step kept open.

desc_zh: 坐在砖沿回望，浅笑。粉花露肩与棕包同在，对岸木构尖顶虚开。香蕉叶与暖光把水岸写得很软。
desc_en: Seated on brick, looking back with a soft smile. Floral off-shoulder and brown tote; a peaked wooden roof soft across the water. Banana leaves and warm light soften the shore.

desc_zh: 人字砖道上站定，粉花鼓袖与黑裤。棕榈与水面、白篷建筑虚在身后。神情平静，包与手机同握，像傍晚散步的收束。
desc_en: Standing on herringbone brick: floral sleeves, black trousers. Palm, water, and white canopy soft behind. Calm face; tote and phone in hand—an evening walk closing.

desc_zh: 全身略侧，浅笑对镜。粉紫碎花鼓袖与黑喇叭裤，紫壳手机与棕包同握。水面映着白篷，紫红叶在一侧点色。
desc_en: Full figure slightly angled, soft smile. Pink-lilac floral sleeves, black flares; purple phone and brown tote. Water mirrors white canopy; purple-red leaves accent one side.

desc_zh: 室内暖琥珀光，手握复古黄拨号电话听筒。粉花鼓袖，口微张像正说话。紫蓝小花虚在前景，波点白物与木格栅同在，玩笑感很轻。
desc_en: Warm amber room light; a vintage yellow rotary receiver at the ear. Floral sleeves, mouth open mid-word. Soft purple blooms in front; a dotted white object and wood grille—lighthearted, quiet.

desc_zh: 黑齿状遮阳篷写着 Vintage Art & Tea，窗内暖灯隐约。常春藤几乎吞掉白墙，茶具剪影灯箱亮着。楼下红绿灌木托住前景，像被城市藏起来的一角。
desc_en: A scalloped black awning reads Vintage Art & Tea; warm pendants glow inside. Ivy nearly swallows the white wall; a tea-bowl lightbox shines. Red-green shrubs hold the foreground—a corner the city keeps quiet.

desc_zh: 前景橙黄老楼层层叠起，窗外挂着空调外机。后方玻璃高楼竖起红尖顶与天线。蓝天干净，新旧城市在一帧里并排站着。
desc_en: Layered orange-yellow mid-rises fill the front, AC units on the walls. Behind, a glass tower lifts a red peak and antenna. Clear blue sky—old and new standing side by side.

desc_zh: 高处俯看，圣弥厄尔教堂双尖顶与红瓦醒目。米黄楼群铺到海边，货轮与小岛灯塔在天际。厚德字样落在近处墙面，青岛的红瓦蓝天被写得很满。
desc_en: From above, St. Michael's twin red spires rise clear. Cream rooftops run to the bay; a freighter and a small island lighthouse sit on the horizon. Virtue lettering on a near wall—Qingdao's red tiles and blue sea, full.

desc_zh: 双尖顶教堂居中，红瓦米黄墙铺展。海湾淡蓝，货轮与小青岛灯塔远在天际。紫花点缀楼间，光柔，像把港口城写进静气。
desc_en: Twin-spired cathedral centered; red tiles and cream walls spread out. Pale blue bay; freighter and Xiaoqingdao lighthouse far off. Purple blossoms between buildings—soft light, the port city held quiet.

desc_zh: 俯看红橙瓦顶连绵，绿树爬墙。远处山头红球与天线立着，玻璃高楼一角刺入灰蓝天。老城区的密度，被雾天压得很轻。
desc_en: A sea of orange-red roofs; ivy climbs walls. Red spheres and a mast on the hill; a glass tower edges a grey-blue sky. Old-town density softened by haze.

desc_zh: 高处看红瓦院落，卡通装置与黄伞挤在巷中。更远处海水与灰舰影隐约。历史街区与一时热闹叠在一起，像旅途里忽然抬头的一瞥。
desc_en: From above, red roofs ring a courtyard of cartoon props and yellow umbrellas. Grey ships and sea soft beyond. Historic fabric and a brief bustle stacked—one glance upward on the road.

desc_zh: 背影靠银栏，黑绿拼色外套虚在前景。焦点落在远方双尖顶教堂与红瓦城。灰云压顶，像把眺望写成沉默。
desc_en: Back to camera at a silver rail; black-and-sage jacket soft in front. Focus on twin red spires and tiled roofs. Grey cloud overhead—looking out held as silence.

desc_zh: 人影略实一些，仍背对镜头。红瓦与双塔在阴天下铺开，海线细细一条。外套与灰裤安静，城市在身前展开。
desc_en: Figure a little sharper, still facing away. Red roofs and twin spires under overcast light; a thin sea line. Jacket and grey trousers quiet—the city opening ahead.

desc_zh: 红瓦米黄楼叠到绿山脚，山顶红球与塔清晰。云层厚，光匀。没有海，只有城里的层次，一层一层往上推。
desc_en: Red tiles and cream walls climb to a green hill; red spheres and a mast clear on top. Thick cloud, even light. No sea—only urban layers pushing upward.

title_en: From the Lane to the Harbor
desc_zh: 红瓦巷落与充气装置、黄伞同在近景。远处港区与灰舰、淡海蓝连成一线。老城热闹与港口沉默并排放着。
desc_en: Red-roof lanes, inflatable props, and yellow umbrellas near. Harbor, grey ships, and pale sea in one distant line. Old-town bustle and port quiet side by side.

desc_zh: 左为教堂双尖顶，右为玻璃高楼群，海从缝隙透出。红瓦米黄与冷色塔楼并置。阴天把对比写得干净，像城市自己的分界线。
desc_en: Twin church spires left, glass towers right; sea slips through the gap. Red tiles and cream against cool high-rises. Overcast light keeps the contrast clean—a city's own dividing line.

desc_zh: 俯看窄街挤满橙棚，红瓦屋顶铺开。教堂双塔与高楼尖顶同在天际，海湾隐约。热闹在脚下，远景却很静。
desc_en: From above, a narrow street packed with orange awnings; red roofs spread. Twin spires and a peaked tower on the skyline; bay soft beyond. Bustle underfoot, quiet in the distance.

title_en: Blue Sash at the Church Wall
desc_zh: 低机位，白石圣母像双手合十，宝蓝腰带醒目。身后是玫瑰窗与尖拱的教堂石墙。灰天匀光，现代楼一角虚在树后。
desc_en: From low: white stone Mary, hands joined, a vivid blue sash. Rose window and lancets on the church wall behind. Even grey sky; a modern block soft beyond trees.

desc_zh: 室内仰看，木读经台与白纱烛台在红毯台阶上。穹顶壁画与彩窗、拉丁横幅同在。金色与宝蓝交叠，把肃静写进暖光。
desc_en: Indoors, looking up: carved wood ambo and veiled candle on red carpet steps. Ceiling mural, stained glass, Latin banners. Gold and blue hold the quiet in warm light.

desc_zh: 深蓝水面，白帆与游艇密密泊成一线。右侧帆形白建筑与信号旗清晰，天空高远。奥帆中心一带的风，被收成干净的蓝白。
desc_en: Deep blue water; white sails and yachts docked in a dense line. Sail-like white architecture and signal flags on the right; high sky. The Olympic sailing harbor held as clean blue and white.

desc_zh: 同一港湾，蓝天更满，桅杆竖成节奏。白艇与控制塔、帆形屋顶同在远景。水面微澜，海鸥几点，像被风擦亮的午后。
desc_en: Same harbor, fuller blue; masts keep a rhythm. White craft, a control tower, sail-like roofs beyond. Light ripples, a few gulls—an afternoon polished by wind.

desc_zh: 前景海面飞起一群鸥，岸线绿树与红色螺旋雕塑醒目。玻璃高楼与红顶住宅挤在天际。蓝天干净，像把城市海风写成一张明信片。
desc_en: Gulls lift over teal water; green shore and the red May Wind coil clear. Glass towers and red-roof residences on the skyline. Clean blue—city sea breeze as a postcard.

desc_zh: 阳光把海面点成碎金，鸥鸟贴水。右侧玻璃楼与球形建筑，左侧绿岬。黄浮标一点，把辽阔收成可走的航线感。
desc_en: Sun turns the sea into glitter; gulls skim low. Glass towers and a sphere right, green headland left. One yellow buoy—vastness given a navigable line.

desc_zh: 俯看港池，红篷白壳小艇排成整齐行列。后方白灰游艇与岸上楼群。深蓝水面映着船体，秩序感干净。
desc_en: From above, red-canopy white boats dock in neat rows. Larger yachts and shore towers behind. Deep blue mirrors the hulls—order kept clean.

desc_zh: 大半幅蓝天，堤上五环雕塑与一排红篷艇。远山淡蓝。颜色简单，像奥帆记忆被风吹成静物。
desc_en: Sky fills most of the frame; Olympic rings on the pier, a line of red-canopy boats. Pale blue hills. Simple color—Olympic sailing memory held as still life.

desc_zh: 白帆艇一字排开，船号红字清晰，桅杆推向远方。帆形白建筑与五环在尽头。蓝白对比利落，像把港口写成节奏。
desc_en: White sailboats in a straight line, red hull numbers clear; masts lead away. Sail-like roofs and Olympic rings at the end. Crisp blue and white—the harbor as rhythm.

desc_zh: 前景褐礁与白沫，中景深蓝细浪。天际马士基货轮与小影点点。晴空无云，辽阔被压成一条水平线。
desc_en: Brown rocks and white foam in front; fine deep-blue ripples beyond. A Maersk freighter and tiny silhouettes on the horizon. Cloudless sky—vastness held to one level line.

desc_zh: 白塔占满竖幅，灯笼室后日晕炸开。栏杆与小窗清楚，远处海与城影。逆光把灯塔写成一个干净的符号。
desc_en: White tower fills the vertical; sunburst flares behind the lantern room. Rail and small windows clear; sea and city soft beyond. Backlight makes the lighthouse a clean sign.

desc_zh: 低机位，白塔贴着无云钴蓝天。灯笼室黑顶银栏，基座白墙与石板。颜色只剩蓝与白，像把海岸收成极简。
desc_en: From low, white tower against cloudless cobalt. Black lantern roof, silver rail; white base and stone paving. Only blue and white—the coast reduced to minimal.

desc_zh: 暮色深蓝，白塔中段被紫光打亮，灯笼室暖白。堤上旗杆与暖灯成排。蓝调时分，港口把白天的热闹换成静。
desc_en: Deep twilight blue; purple light on the white shaft, warm white in the lantern. Flagpoles and warm lamps along the pier. Blue hour—the harbor trades daytime bustle for quiet.

desc_zh: 褐礁近景，白沫轻拍。天际一叶白帆，货轮剪影更远。晴空无云，海蓝饱和，像把航程缩成一个点。
desc_en: Brown rocks close, foam light at the base. One white sail on the horizon; freighter silhouettes farther. Cloudless sky, saturated blue—the voyage reduced to a point.

desc_zh: 左下角石崖与黄花灌木，暗礁拍浪。海面碎光铺满，远方一点船影。晴空高亮，像站在岸边把风记进眼睛。
desc_en: Cliff and yellow-flowered scrub lower left; dark rocks take the surf. Glitter covers the water; one distant wake. Bright clear sky—wind kept in the eyes at the edge.

desc_zh: 米白短袖与灰裤，侧目迈步。木栏红救生圈，远山淡蓝。草地点缀，像把海边散步写成不经意的一帧。
desc_en: Cream tee and grey trousers, mid-stride, gaze aside. Wooden rail, red lifebuoy; pale blue hills beyond. Grass underfoot—a shore walk kept casual.

desc_zh: 前景褐礁与清浅海水，中景碎光铺开。天际灯塔影与货轮点点。蓝天无云，辽阔被礁石轻轻按住。
desc_en: Brown rocks and clear shallows in front; glitter across the mid sea. Lighthouse silhouette and freighters on the horizon. Cloudless blue—vastness lightly pinned by stone.

desc_zh: 俯看褐礁与翠绿青苔，石梁斜入深蓝。海鸥立在暗礁顶，远岩耸起。阳光把颜色推得很满，像把潮线写成静物。
desc_en: From above: terracotta rock and emerald moss; stone beams slant into deep blue. Gulls on a dark outcrop; a far crag rises. Sun saturates the shore—tide line as still life.

desc_zh: 大半幅钴蓝天，一人剪影坐在栏前。远山淡蓝，海平线干净。一只鸟掠过，像把沉默交给风。
desc_en: Cobalt fills most of the frame; a seated silhouette at the rail. Pale hills, clean horizon. One bird crosses—silence given to the wind.

desc_zh: 浅蓝海面，褐礁与深色防波堤伸向右。左方小摩托艇留白浪。晴空无云，像把午后的海面擦得很亮。
desc_en: Pale blue sea; brown rocks and a dark stone jetty reach right. A small motorboat leaves a white wake left. Cloudless sky—afternoon water wiped bright.

desc_zh: 前景暗礁与青苔，一人立在蓝桨板上。对岸红瓦洋房、白圆建筑与摩天轮、玻璃高楼并排。海城交界，像把休闲写进天际线。
desc_en: Dark mossy rocks in front; one figure upright on a blue paddleboard. Across the water: red-tiled villas, a white round building, Ferris wheel, glass towers. Shore and city meeting—leisure written into the skyline.

desc_zh: 前景卵石与矮石堤，中景深蓝海水。对岸楼群贴着绿山，更远一脉淡蓝山脊。晴空干净，像把回望写成宽屏。
desc_en: Pebbles and a low stone wall in front; deep blue mid water. Towers against a green mountain; a farther pale ridge. Clear sky—looking back held as a wide screen.

desc_zh: 谷底一簇白墙红檐的屋舍，被新绿和枯黄的草坡托着。中景丘陵一层层后退，远峰罩着蓝雾，顶上薄雪。焦距把距离压扁，人烟显得很小。
desc_en: A cluster of white walls and red eaves sits in the valley, held by slopes of new green and dry gold. Rolling hills recede in layers; the far peak holds blue haze and a skim of snow. Telephoto compression makes the settlement feel very small.

desc_zh: 深色山脊覆着斑驳薄雪，积云在头顶柱状升起，边缘受光，基部偏暗。山脚一排铁塔和电线横过，细得像被风拉直的线。蓝白与炭褐对峙，冷，却很开阔。
desc_en: Dark ridges hold a dappled skim of snow; a cumulus column rises overhead—lit edges, a shaded base. A line of pylons and wires crosses the foot of the slope, thin as if pulled taut by wind. Blue-white against charcoal brown: cold, and open.

desc_zh: 白雪覆在几座圆脊上，积云铺满蓝天，云隙里有光洒下来。中景铁塔连成一条亮线，横过暗谷；左下盘山公路细细弯着。天空比山更大，人的痕迹只是轻轻一笔。
desc_en: Snow lies on rounded ridges; cumulus fills the blue, light spilling through the gaps. A bright run of pylons crosses the dark valley; a mountain road curves thinly at lower left. The sky is larger than the mountains—human traces only a light mark.

title_en: Twin Towers on the Snow Slope
desc_zh: 深蓝天空衬着碎白积云，雪峰参差。坡上残雪与深色灌丛斑驳交错，两座铁塔立在近处，下面有一条细路。冷，干净，结构和雪分得清清楚楚。
desc_en: A deep-blue sky holds broken white cloud over staggered snow peaks. Patchy snow and dark scrub tessellate the slope; two pylons stand near, a thin road below. Cold and clean—structure and snow kept distinct.

title_en: A Burst of Light in the Valley
desc_zh: 山坡沉在深蓝阴影里，盘山公路弯成一道亮线，一辆车正走在弯里。谷底忽然亮起一团刺目的反光，把屋顶和水面一并点着。冷色铺满全景，只留这一处白。
desc_en: Slopes sink into deep navy shadow; the mountain road curves as a bright thread, one car in the bend. At the valley floor, a hard glare of light catches roofs and water at once. Cool tones fill the frame—only that white remains.

desc_zh: 一列尖峰排开，雪面受着冷而薄的晚光，阴坡沉成蓝灰。天空有一层淡云，远峰若隐若现。没有人迹，只有体积和安静。
desc_en: A line of sharp peaks stands in thin, cool evening light; the shadowed faces fall to blue-grey. A veil of cloud sits in the sky, farther summits only half seen. No human trace—only volume and quiet.

desc_zh: 主峰顶上压着一团圆厚的帽云，边缘被晚光染成浅粉。两侧雪岭退开，近处岩脊还留着冷影。蓝天干净，山把一天里最后的暖意收在最高处。
desc_en: A thick, rounded cap cloud sits the main summit, its edge flushed pale pink by late light. Snow ridges fall away on both sides; the near rock still holds cold shadow. The sky is clean—the mountain keeps the day’s last warmth at its highest point.

desc_zh: 近处一座尖顶山脊剪成黑影，后面层峦淡去。厚云横在日边，边缘烧着亮金，天上的薄云也被染成暖橙。山已经暗尽，光都还给了天空。
desc_en: A sharp ridge cuts a black silhouette; farther ranges fade behind it. A heavy cloud lies across the sun, edges burning gold, the upper wisps washed warm orange. The mountains have gone dark—the light given back to the sky.

desc_zh: 暗处的针叶从近处探进来，框住一湖细碎的波光。对岸新绿浓密，草地上有人和一顶浅色帐篷，显得很小。水是灰绿的，风在上面轻轻写字。
desc_en: Dark conifer branches lean in from close, framing a lake of fine, broken glitter. The far bank is dense with new green; tiny figures and a pale tent sit on the grass. The water is grey-green, the wind writing lightly across it.

desc_zh: 几头褐牛与花牛散在一条条鲜绿的浅滩上低头吃草。水面把滩地隔成平行的色带，后景是石头、枯木和深林。安静，像把高原的一天铺成绿与灰。
desc_en: Brown and piebald cattle graze heads-down on bright green shoals. Water cuts the ground into parallel bands; rocks, driftwood and deep forest hold the back. Quiet—as if a highland day were laid out in green and grey.

desc_zh: 近处草绿坡面翻起来，空阔而近。谷左红檐屋舍贴着树丛，左山被云影压暗，右岭还在阳光里。厚云走得很快，阴晴就写在同一道山谷里。
desc_en: A green slope lifts in the foreground, close and open. Red-eaved houses sit among trees at left in the valley. Cloud-shadow darkens the left mountain while the right ridges stay in sun. The heavy cloud is moving—sun and shade written in one valley.

desc_zh: 一只旱獭从土洞里探出头，嘴微张，像刚醒。身旁一块灰石，几朵小白花开在矮灌丛边。后面土坎和草坡虚过去，注意力全在这双眼睛上。
desc_en: A marmot looks out of its burrow, mouth slightly open, as if just awake. A grey stone sits beside it; a few small white flowers open at the low shrubs. The bank and slope fall soft behind—attention held by those eyes.

desc_zh: 几座白墙红顶的院落落在谷底树丛里，金饰在屋顶上轻轻发亮。后面青山高耸，一条浅色的路从坡上折下来。前景树木齐整，像把一座寺院轻轻放进草场。
desc_en: White-walled, red-roofed courtyards sit among trees on the valley floor, gold trim catching lightly on the roofs. A high green mountain rises behind; a pale path zigzags down the slope. The near trees stand even—as if a monastery had been set down gently in the meadow.

title_en: A Long Road Across the Moor
desc_zh: 一条浅色公路在褐色草甸上弯着延伸，翻过一处垭口。近坡枯黄，远处岭谷已是深绿，更远的雪峰停在云下。路上几乎看不见车，风好像比路更先到。
desc_en: A pale road bends across brown moorland and climbs a pass. The near slopes are withered gold; farther ridges turn deep green, and snow peaks wait under cloud. Almost no cars—the wind seems to arrive before the road does.
